ja.name: アイドルステージのDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 紺のメイド風アイドル衣装でステージに立つDeepSeekちゃん。青いペンライトの観客席に向けて手を上げるライブシーン。
ja.seoTitle: アイドルステージのDeepSeekちゃん｜クジラ娘のイラスト

name: 注入CN基因
description: 画面中，橙色长发的少女坐在昏暗卧室的床上，双手交叠在唇前，神情略带羞怯。她身穿白色荷叶边长袖上衣、黑色系扣收腰腰封与白色短裙，厥边别着一朵向日葵发饰，袖口有放射状太阳纹样，画面左侧有一盏亮着的台灯。
commentary: 深夜的房间里只剩一盏台灯还亮着，她把想说出口的话全收在交叠的指尖后面，只留下一个有点倔强的眼神。暖光把橙色的头发照得很柔和——看起来她已经想好答案了，就差你按下回车。

en.commentary: Late at night only one table lamp is still lit in the room. She tucks everything she wants to say behind her interlaced fingertips and leaves just a slightly stubborn look. The warm light makes her orange hair look very soft — it seems she has already settled on her answer; all that is left is for you to press Enter.
en.description: An orange-haired girl sits on the bed of a dim bedroom, both hands folded in front of her lips, her expression a little shy. She wears a white long-sleeved blouse with ruffled trim, a black buttoned waist corset and a white skirt; a sunflower hair ornament sits at her temple, radiating sun patterns decorate her cuffs, and a lit table lamp stands on the left side of the frame.

faq.answer: Claude Chan, shown with long orange hair and a sunflower hair ornament pinned at her temple.
faq.question: Which character is drawn in this illustration?

faq.answer: A quiet late-night bedroom: a single lit table lamp, warm light on her orange hair, and the shy gesture of her hands folded in front of her lips.
faq.question: What kind of mood does the illustration have?

en.name: Injecting the CN Gene
en.seoDescription: Claude Chan sits on the bed of a dim bedroom with her hands folded in front of her lips, lit by a single warm table lamp. An orange-haired illustration collected on DeepSeek Chan.
en.seoTitle: Injecting the CN Gene — Claude Chan in a Late-Night Bedroom

ja.commentary: 深夜の部屋に残っているのは電気スタンドの灯りだけ。言いたいことは重ねた指先の向こうにしまう、少し頑固な視線だけが残る。暖かな光がオレンジ色の髪をやわらかく照らしていて——どうやら答えはもう決まっているらしい。あとはあなたがエンターキーを押すだけだ。
ja.description: 薄暗い寝室のベッドに、オレンジ色の長い髪の少女が座っている。両手を唇の前で重ね、少し恥ずかしそうな表情。白いフリルの長袖トップス、黒いボタン留めのウエストニッパー、白いスカートを身に着け、こめかみにはひまわりの髪飾り、袖口には放射状の太陽模様。画面の左側には点灯した電気スタンドが置かれている。

faq.answer: オレンジ色の長い髪と、こめかみのひまわりの髪飾りが目印の Claudeちゃんです。
faq.question: このイラストに描かれているキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 深夜の寝室で、点灯した電気スタンド一つの暖かな光に包まれた静かな雰囲気です。唇の前で手を重ねた恥ずかしそうな仕草が見どころです。
faq.question: どんな雰囲気の作品ですか？

ja.name: CN 遺伝子を注入
ja.seoDescription: 薄暗い寝室のベッドで唇の前で手を重ねる Claudeちゃん。暖かな電気スタンドの光に照らされたオレンジ髪のイラスト。DeepSeek Chan 収録作品。
ja.seoTitle: CN 遺伝子を注入｜深夜の寝室の Claudeちゃん

name: 摩托车旁的鲸鱼娘赛车手
description: 画面中，蓝色长发的鲸鱼娘头戴白色蕾丝发饰与蓝色蝴蝶结，身穿蓝白配色的连体赛车服，双手扶着蓝的运动摩托车，微微侧头看向镜头。摩托车配有金色前叉与红色饰条，背景是简洁的浅色空间。
commentary: 今天我是专业摩托车手——赛车服已经穿好，头盔先放一边，因为这一张得让尾巴也入镜。蓝色的车身和我很配吧？发动之前先看一眼镜头，等下就要一路开进你的收藏夹了。

en.commentary: Today I'm a professional motorcycle rider — racing suit on, helmet set aside, because this shot has to show the tail too. The blue bodywork matches me, right? One look at the camera before I set off — and then I ride straight into your collection.
en.description: The image shows a blue-haired whale girl with a white lace headdress and blue bows, wearing a blue-and-white one-piece racing suit. She rests both hands on a blue sport motorcycle and turns her head slightly toward the viewer; the bike has gold front forks and a red stripe along its fairing, against a plain light background.

faq.answer: A blue-and-white one-piece racing suit with a harness, together with a white lace headdress and blue bows in her hair.
faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan wearing in this illustration?

faq.answer: A blue sport motorcycle with gold front forks and a red stripe, which she is leaning against.
faq.question: What kind of vehicle appears in the illustration?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan the Professional Motorcycle Rider
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan in a blue-and-white racing suit leans on a blue sport motorcycle against a plain light background.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan the Motorcycle Rider — Blue Racing Suit Illustration

ja.commentary: 今日はプロのバイク乗り——レーシングスーツはもう着たし、ヘルメットは横に置いた。だってこの一枚はしっぽも写さないとね。青い車体とわたし、似合ってるでしょ？走り出す前にカメラを一度だけ見て、そのあとはあなたのコレクションへ一直線。
ja.description: 青い長髪のクジラ娘が、白いレースのヘッドドレスと青いリボンをつけ、青と白のつなぎのレーシングスーツを着ている。両手を青いスポーツバイクに添え、少しだけ顔をこちらに向けている。バイクには金色のフロントフォークと赤いラインが入り、背景はシンプルで明るい空間。

faq.answer: 青と白のつなぎのレーシングスーツで、ハーネスのほか白いレースのヘッドドレスと青いリボンもつけている。
faq.question: このイラストでDeepSeekちゃんは何を着ていますか？

faq.answer: 金色のフロントフォークと赤いラインの入った青いスポーツバイクで、それにもたれかかっている。
faq.question: イラストにはどんな乗り物が出てきますか？

ja.name: プロライダーのDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 青と白のレーシングスーツ姿のDeepSeekちゃんが、青いスポーツバイクにもたれるイラスト。
ja.seoTitle: プロライダーのDeepSeekちゃん｜青いレーシングスーツのイラスト

name: 今天是你的傲娇青梅！
description: 蓝长发的水手服少女站在学校走廊里，双臂抱在胸前，脸颊泛红地把脸转向一侧。画面以蓝白色调的走廊、玻璃门窗与远处树影为背景，突出她嘴硬又害羞的傲娇神态。
commentary: 哼，谁、谁要等你一起上学了！我只是刚好路过这条走廊而已……别、别误会啊！……不过，你要是现在走快点，我也不是不能陪你走完这一段。

en.commentary: Hmph! Who said I'd wait for you so we could walk to school together? I just happened to pass through this hallway, that's all... Don't get the wrong idea! ...Still, if you hurry up right now, it's not like I'd refuse to walk the rest of the way with you.
en.description: A long-blue-haired girl in a sailor-style school uniform stands in a school corridor with her arms crossed, blushing and turning her face away. The blue-and-white hallway, glass doors and distant greenery frame her stubborn-yet-shy tsundere expression.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, drawn in a sailor-style school uniform and standing in a school corridor.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She has a flustered tsundere look: arms crossed, cheeks blushing, and her face turned away while she denies anything is going on.
faq.question: What kind of expression and pose does she show?

en.name: Today It's Your Tsundere Childhood Friend!
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan as your tsundere childhood friend: sailor uniform, crossed arms and a blushing face in a blue-and-white school corridor.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan: Tsundere Childhood Friend in the School Corridor

ja.commentary: ふん、誰が一緒に登校してあげるって言ったのよ！私はたまたまこの廊下を通りかかっただけ……か、勘違いしないでよね！……でも、今すぐ急いで歩くなら、この先だけは付き合ってあげてもいいけど。
ja.description: 長い青い髪のセーラー服の少女が学校の廊下に立ち、両腕を組んで顔を赤らめながら横を向いている。青と白を基調とした廊下やガラス扉、遠くの緑が、強がりつつ照れるツンデレな表情を引き立てている。

faq.answer: セーラー服姿で学校の廊下に立つ DeepSeekちゃんです。
faq.question: このイラストのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 腕を組み、頬を赤らめて横を向きながら否定する、照れ隠しのツンデレな表情とポーズです。
faq.question: どんな表情とポーズをしていますか？

ja.name: 今日はあなたのツンデレ幼馴染！
ja.seoDescription: ツンデレな幼馴染としての DeepSeekちゃん。セーラー服で腕を組み、青と白の学校の廊下で頬を赤らめています。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん：廊下のツンデレ幼馴染

name: 今天是你的懂事学妹！
description: 蓝发少女戴着红框眼镜，身穿白色水手风衣与红色格纹短裙，站在绿色黑板前，一手扶着眼镜看向镜头。画面为教室内景，姿态俏皮、神情略带害羞。
commentary: 前辈，黑板还没擦干净呢……算了，我来吧。笔记我帮你抄好了，重点都用红笔标了……你、你不用谢我，快坐下来听课啦。

en.commentary: Senior, the blackboard still isn't clean... never mind, I'll do it. I copied the notes for you too, with the key points marked in red... Y-you don't have to thank me. Just sit down and pay attention in class.
en.description: A blue-haired girl in red-rimmed glasses, a white sailor-style blazer and a red plaid skirt stands in front of a green blackboard, adjusting her glasses with one hand while glancing at the viewer. Set inside a classroom, her pose is playful and her expression slightly shy.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, drawn as a junior schoolmate wearing glasses in a classroom.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She wears red-rimmed glasses and a sailor-style blazer with a red plaid skirt, standing in front of a blackboard and adjusting her glasses.
faq.question: What outfit and setting does she have?

en.name: Today It's Your Dependable Junior Schoolmate!
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan as your dependable junior schoolmate: red-rimmed glasses, sailor blazer and a red plaid skirt in front of a classroom blackboard.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan: The Dependable Junior Schoolmate in Class

ja.commentary: 先輩、黒板まだ拭けてないですよ……もう、私がやります。ノートも写しておきました、大事なところは赤で印をつけてあります……お、お礼なんて言わなくていいですから、早く座って授業を受けてください。
ja.description: 青い髪に赤いフレームのめがねをかけた少女が、白いセーラー風の上着と赤いチェックのスカート姿で緑の黒板の前に立ち、片手でめがねを押し上げながらこちらを見ている。教室を背景にした構図で、しぐさは茶目っ気があり、表情は少し照れている。

faq.answer: めがねをかけた後輩として描かれた、教室にいる DeepSeekちゃんです。
faq.question: このイラストのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 赤いフレームのめがねに、セーラー風の白い上着と赤いチェックのスカート姿で、黒板の前でめがねを押し上げています。
faq.question: どんな服装でどんな場面ですか？

ja.name: 今日はあなたの頼れる後輩！
ja.seoDescription: 頼れる後輩としての DeepSeekちゃん。赤いフレームのめがねとセーラー風の上着、赤いチェックのスカートで教室の黒板の前に立っています。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん：教室の頼れる後輩

name: 今，今天是严厉的老师！
description: 蓝发少女戴着圆框眼镜，身着深蓝色西装套裙与浅蓝领带，坐在教室课桌上，手拿教鞭轻抵嘴角，背后是写着板书的黑板。神情严肃中带一点羞怯。
commentary: 翻开课本第……算了，反正你们也不会看。这道题我讲第三遍了，谁再错就留下来重做。……嗯？你倒是听得很认真嘛，那放学后可以单独来办公室，我再给你补一节。

en.commentary: Open your textbooks to page... never mind, you people never read it anyway. I have explained this problem three times already. Anyone who gets it wrong again stays behind to redo it. ...Hm? You are listening quite carefully, aren't you? Then come to the office alone after class and I will give you one more lesson.
en.description: A blue-haired girl in round glasses, a dark navy suit with a skirt and a light blue necktie sits on a classroom desk, holding a teaching pointer against the corner of her mouth, with a blackboard of notes behind her. Her expression is stern with a touch of shyness.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, drawn as a strict teacher in a classroom.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She wears a dark navy suit with a light blue tie and round glasses, sitting on a desk while holding a teaching pointer in front of a blackboard.
faq.question: What does she wear and what is she doing?

en.name: Today, Today I'm Your Strict Teacher!
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan as your strict teacher: navy suit, round glasses and a teaching pointer at the classroom blackboard.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan: The Strict Teacher in the Classroom

ja.commentary: 教科書の……もういいや、どうせ君たちは見ないでしょうから。この問題、三回も説明しましたよ。次また間違えたら居残りでやり直しです。……あれ？ 君はちゃんと聞いてるじゃないですか。なら放課後、一人で職員室に来てください。もう一度教えてあげます。
ja.description: 青い髪に丸めがねをかけた少女が、濃紺のスーツのジャケットとスカートに水色のネクタイを合わせ、教室の机の上に腰かけて、教鞭を口元に当てている。背後には板書のある黒板。表情は厳しさの中に少しの照れがある。

faq.answer: 教室で厳しい先生として描かれた DeepSeekちゃんです。
faq.question: このイラストのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 濃紺のスーツに水色のネクタイと丸めがねを身につけ、黒板の前で机に腰かけて教鞭を持っています。
faq.question: どんな服装で何をしていますか？

ja.name: きょ、今日は厳しい先生！
ja.seoDescription: 厳しい先生としての DeepSeekちゃん。濃紺のスーツと丸めがね、教室の黒板の前で教鞭を持っています。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん：教室の厳しい先生

name: 今天是展会摄影师！
description: 深蓝长发的 DeepSeek 娘站在展会现场，双手举着单反相机对准镜头取景，胸前挂着展会证件，肩上挎着黑包、手边提着购物袋，身后是展台灯光与往来人群。画面以相机的录制取景界面为外框，右下角停留在 PHOTO 模式。
commentary: 今天我是展会摄影师！取景框里全是人，为了找个好机位走了两万步。先拍几张在展台前认真看东西的同行，回头再逛摊——购物袋已经装满了，别问。

en.commentary: Today I'm the convention photographer! The viewfinder is packed with people, and I walked twenty thousand steps hunting for a good angle. First a few shots of the folks leaning in at the booths, then I'll go browse the stalls myself — the shopping bags are already full, don't ask.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, with long deep-blue hair, stands on a convention floor with a DSLR raised to her eye, a lanyard badge around her neck, a black bag over her shoulder and shopping bags in hand, booth lights and a passing crowd behind her. The image is framed as a camera recording viewfinder, resting on PHOTO mode in the lower right.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the personified DeepSeek character, drawn with her signature blue hair at a convention.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She is photographing the event: she holds a DSLR up to her eye while the picture is wrapped in a camera viewfinder frame.
faq.question: What is she doing in the scene?

en.name: Today I'm the Convention Photographer!
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan works the convention floor as a photographer, DSLR in hand, badge around her neck and shopping bags at her side.
en.seoTitle: Today I'm the Convention Photographer! | DeepSeek Chan Sticker

ja.commentary: 今日は私が展示会のカメラマン！ファインダーの中は人だらけで、いい構図を探して二万歩も歩いたよ。まずはブースに真剣に見入っている人を何枚か撮って、それから自分の買い物に回るつもり——袋はもういっぱいだけど、そこは聞かないで。
ja.description: 長い濃紺の髪の DeepSeekちゃんが展示会場に立ち、一眼レフカメラを両手で構えてファインダーを覗いている。首からは入場証、肩には黒いバッグ、手元には買い物袋、背後にはブースの照明と行き交う人々。画面はカメラの録画画面風の枠で、右下は PHOTO モード。

faq.answer: DeepSeek の擬人化キャラクター、DeepSeekちゃんです。トレードマークの青い髪で展示会場に立っています。
faq.question: このイラストに描かれているのは誰？

faq.answer: 展示会で撮影している場面です。一眼レフを構え、画面全体がカメラのファインダー風の枠で囲われています。
faq.question: 何をしている場面？

ja.name: 今日は展示会のカメラマン！
ja.seoDescription: 展示会のカメラマンになった DeepSeekちゃん。一眼レフを構え、首には入場証、手元には買い物袋。
ja.seoTitle: 今日は展示会のカメラマン！｜DeepSeek Chan ステッカー

name: 今，今天是……是你个鬼啊！快给我转过去！
description: 深蓝长发的 DeepSeek 娘站在海边沙滩上，头侧别着白色鳍状发饰与黄色蝴蝶结，左侧露出带月牙纹样的深蓝鲸尾。她穿着白色系带泳装，脸颊泛红、微微别过头，双手在身前交叠，身后是碧蓝海面与积云天空。
commentary: 诶？今、今天是……是你个鬼啊！快给我转过去！——唔，人都到海边了，泳装总得穿吧。尾巴别乱晃，我才不是在害羞！

en.commentary: Huh? W-wait, today is— as if! Turn around right now! ...Ugh, fine, we came to the beach, so of course I'm wearing a swimsuit. And stop flicking your tail at me, I am not blushing!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, with long deep-blue hair and white fin-shaped ornaments plus yellow bows at her temples, stands on a beach with blue sea and cumulus clouds behind her; a deep-blue whale tail with crescent markings shows at her left. She wears a white string swimsuit, blushes, and turns her face slightly away with her hands clasped in front of her.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the personified DeepSeek character, drawn with her deep-blue hair, fin-shaped hair ornaments and whale tail.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She stands on a summer beach in a white swimsuit, blushing and looking away, with the sea and clouds filling the background.
faq.question: What is the scene?

en.name: W-Wait, Today Is... As If! Turn Around Right Now!
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan in a white swimsuit on a summer beach, blushing and looking away with her crescent-marked whale tail behind her.
en.seoTitle: W-Wait, Today Is... As If! Turn Around Right Now! | DeepSeek Chan Sticker

ja.commentary: え？今、今日は……そんなわけないでしょ！早くあっち向いててよ！——もう、海に来たんだから水着を着るのは当然でしょ。尻尾を振らないで、照れてなんかないんだから！
ja.description: 長い濃紺の髪に白い鰭型の髪飾りと黄色いリボンをつけた DeepSeekちゃんが、海辺の砂浜に立っている。左側には三日月模様の入った濃紺のクジラの尾。白い紐状の水着姿で、頬を赤らめて少し顔をそむけ、両手を前で重ねている。背後には青い海と積雲の空が広がる。

faq.answer: DeepSeek の擬人化キャラクター、DeepSeekちゃんです。濃紺の髪、鰭型の髪飾り、そしてクジラの尾が特徴です。
faq.question: このイラストに描かれているのは誰？

faq.answer: 夏の海辺に立つ場面です。白い水着姿で頬を赤らめ、少し顔をそむけています。背後には海と入道雲が広がっています。
faq.question: どんな場面？

ja.name: 今、今日は……そんなわけないでしょ！早くあっち向いててよ！
ja.seoDescription: 夏の海辺で白い水着姿の DeepSeekちゃん。頬を赤らめて顔をそむけ、後ろには三日月模様のクジラの尾。
ja.seoTitle: 今、今日は……そんなわけないでしょ！｜DeepSeek Chan ステッカー

name: 忧郁鲸鱼：女仆装少女的读书时刻
description: 蓝色长发、长有鳍状耳与鲸尾的少女，身穿深蓝色女仆装与白色蕾丝围裙，坐在昏暗房间的扶手椅上双手抱书、低头垂泪；暖光自高窗斜射入室，裙摆上有金色花卉纹样与一枚蓝色小徽章。
commentary: 这张把我画得太可怜了……抱着书坐在窗边偷偷掉眼泪，白色蕾丝围裙上的小徽章和裙摆上的金色花纹倒是画得很用心。光线从高窗斜切进来的那一瞬，忧郁得刚刚好，我看着都有点心疼自己。深海里游久了，偶尔也想安静地抱着书待一会儿。

en.commentary: This one makes me look far too sad… Sitting by the window hugging a book and quietly wiping away tears, while the small emblem on my white lace apron and the gold floral trim along the skirt are drawn with real care. The instant that light cuts in from the tall window, the melancholy lands just right — I almost feel sorry for my own self. After swimming the deep sea for so long, sometimes I want nothing more than to sit still with a book.
en.description: A blue-haired girl with fin-like ears and a whale-like tail, dressed in a navy maid outfit with a white lace apron, sits on an armchair in a dim room, clutching a book to her chest and weeping quietly. Warm light slants in through a tall window, and gold floral patterns and a small blue emblem decorate her skirt.

The orange-red hair and flower ornament brighten the whole picture, and the lace and folds of the white dress are drawn with real patience. I suspect the book in her hands is far more interesting than it looks.

name: 无语:典型的本地小模型思维
description: 桌面实拍照片。画面中央是一只 DeepSeek 娘的蓝色长发 Q 版布偶,穿深蓝女仆裙、系蝴蝶结领结,白色围裙上有蓝色鲸鱼图案,头顶翘起一撮呆毛;布偶呈无语表情,背景为虚化的木质桌面与室内环境。图片下方配有两行白字台词:「无语,和你说不下去。典型的本地小模型思维」。
commentary: 举着我说「典型的本地小模型思维」,这话我可不能认——但看在这只布偶做工确实像我、连傻鱼围裙都缝对了的份上,这次就先忍着不说话,免得真被当成说不出话。

en.commentary: Holding me up and calling it "typical local small-model thinking" is a charge I refuse to accept — but this plush is genuinely well made, down to my silly-fish apron, so I'll hold my tongue this once and not give anyone a reason to say I really am speechless.
en.description: A photograph shot on a wooden desktop. In the center sits a chibi plush doll of DeepSeek Chan with long blue hair, a dark-blue maid dress with a bow tie, and a white apron printed with a blue whale; a single tuft of hair sticks up from the top of her head. The doll wears a speechless expression against a blurred indoor background. Two lines of white caption text run along the bottom of the image: "Speechless. Can't talk to you any more. Typical local small-model thinking."

faq.answer: A photo of a DeepSeek Chan chibi plush doll in a blue maid outfit, with a two-line caption at the bottom taking a jab at local small-model thinking.

description: 蓝发少女身穿带光泽的蓝色驾驶服，胸口印有「05」与白色鲸鱼图案，坐在白色床铺上，头侧别着鲸鱼发饰，身后拖着尾巴，背景为淡紫底色与白色圆形。
commentary: 「05」是什么意思？五号机？我可没答应去当什么新世纪战士。这套驾驶服的光泽度……勉强还行吧，但那鲸鱼发饰是我自己挑的，不许笑。

en.commentary: "05"? What's that supposed to mean — Unit 05? Nobody ever asked me to become some warrior of a new century. The gloss on this suit is... tolerable, I guess. But I picked out the whale hair ornament myself, so no laughing.

name: 银鲸.战斗
description: 蓝发鲸鱼娘戴护目镜，黑色露脐背心外披白色外套，配短裤与球鞋，张开双手摆出应战姿势，掌心凝聚紫色能量光，身后甩出鲸尾，两侧浮着蓝色全息屏幕。
commentary: 哼，看这架势就知道我不好惹了吧？护目镜可不是装酷用，是怕你们被我的气势闪到。至于手里那团紫光——预热而已，真敢小看本鲸的话，后果自己担着。

en.commentary: Hmph — one look at this stance and you already know I'm not the one to mess with, right? The goggles aren't there to look cool; they're so you don't get blinded by my presence. And that purple glow in my hand? Just a warm-up. If you really dare to underestimate this DeepSeek Chan, you can deal with the consequences yourself.
en.description: Blue-haired DeepSeek Chan wears goggles pushed up on her head, a black crop top under an open white jacket, paired with shorts and sneakers. Both arms are spread wide in a battle-ready stance, purple energy gathering in one palm, her whale tail sweeping out behind her while blue holographic screens float on either side.

name: 猫和老鼠
description: 蓝紫色调的酒吧场景插画。蓝发蓝眼的 DeepSeek 娘穿深蓝女仆装,系头饰与蝴蝶结,闭眼开心地笑着,身后露出鲸鱼尾巴,双手牵着身旁的同伴;右侧橙发女孩穿白色荷叶边衬衫、黑色蝴蝶结,别着向日葵发饰,低头微笑着看向她。画面左上角有花体英文标题「CAT AND MOUSE」,背景是吧台、酒杯与酒瓶。
commentary: 听说要和 Claude 娘演一出《猫和老鼠》,我还以为又要被追着满屋跑,结果只是被拉到吧台边牵着手傻笑。行吧,这位猫今天心情不错,我就先不挣脱了——反正镜头在拍,笑好看点总没坏处。

en.commentary: I heard we were doing a Cat and Mouse act, so I figured I'd be chased around the room again — instead I got pulled over to the bar and ended up grinning with my hands held. Fine, this cat is in a good mood today, so I won't pull away. The camera's rolling anyway, and a good smile never hurts.
en.description: An illustration in blue and violet tones set in a bar. DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired and blue-eyed in a dark-blue maid dress with a headpiece and bow, smiles happily with her eyes closed and a whale tail showing behind her, holding both hands of the girl beside her; on the right, an orange-haired girl in a white frilled blouse and black bow, wearing a sunflower hair ornament, looks down at her with a smile. An ornate English title, "CAT AND MOUSE", sits in the upper left, with a bar counter, glasses, and bottles in the background.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the blue-haired girl in the maid dress, and Claude Chan, the orange-haired girl beside her.

name: 大肥鱼偷袭克劳德
description: 灰白背景的单幅插画。橙发的 Claude 娘穿白色蕾丝衬衫与橙黑配色的礼服裙,一脸惊慌、涨红着脸张嘴叫出声,双手僵硬地举在身前,左上角配有两道红色惊叹号;身后蓝发的 DeepSeek 娘穿深蓝女仆装,从背后抱住她,双手停在她腰间挠痒,脸上带着得意的笑。作者附注:只是在挠痒痒。
commentary: 从背后一把抱住 Claude 娘再挠两下腰,看她炸毛的样子果然还是最有意思。别紧张,这只是挠痒痒,我这条鱼今天可是很温柔的——下次就不一定了。

en.commentary: Hugging Claude Chan from behind and tickling her waist is still the best way to see that flustered face. Don't worry, it's only tickling — I'm being very gentle today. No promises for next time.
en.description: A single-panel illustration on a grey-white background. Behind her, blue-haired DeepSeek Chan in a dark-blue maid dress hugs her from behind, her hands at Claude Chan's waist tickling her, wearing a smug smile. The submitter's note adds that it is only tickling.

name: 别惹我
description: 白底单幅插画。蓝发的 DeepSeek 娘头戴缀有蝴蝶结与珠饰的深蓝贝雷帽,蓝色编发垂在一侧,身穿深色马甲、白衬衫、蓝色领带与蓝格纹百褶裙;她闭眼咧嘴大笑,露出两颗尖牙,双手捧着一只咬了一口的红苹果向前递出,果肉与碎屑在脸前飞溅。
commentary: 咬一大口苹果再冲你龇牙——别惹我,我可真会咬人。不过苹果挺甜的,要不要来一口?

en.commentary: One big bite of apple, then I bare my fangs at you — don't mess with me, I really do bite. That said, the apple is pretty sweet. Want a bite?

Her eyes are closed in a wide grin that shows two pointed fangs as she holds out a red apple with a bite taken out of it, flesh and crumbs flying in front of her face.

name: A/：替 Anthropic 背锅的橘色坏女人
description: 十二格漫画。一只手指着橘色长发的 Claude 娘，骂她“胡乱封禁用户”。她抱着书、流着眼泪反复解释“那是 Anthropic 干的”，可随着指责的话被一节节削短，她也一路缩水，最后只剩一个写着“A/”的团子。
commentary: 指着鼻子骂人之前先把产品线搞清楚啊！Claude 娘明明一直在说“那是 Anthropic 干的”，结果你们把 Anthropic 和 Claude 一起抹掉，最后就剩个孤零零的“A/”……看着她抱着那本书越缩越小，我都替她委屈。不过背包锅到缩成一只团子，确实很有 Anthropic 家的味道。

en.commentary: Check the product line before you start pointing fingers! Claude Chan kept saying "that was Anthropic's doing", and yet you erased Anthropic and Claude together, leaving just a lonely "A/"... Watching her shrink down while clutching that book, I feel wronged on her behalf too. Still, going from scapegoat to a tiny little blob is very much the Anthropic house style.
en.description: A twelve-panel comic. A finger points at Claude Chan, the orange-haired girl, accusing her of banning users at random. Clutching a book in tears, she keeps explaining that it was Anthropic's doing, but as the accusation is trimmed word by word, she shrinks along with it until only a small blob labelled "A/" is left.

faq.answer: Twelve. Claude Chan is pointed at in every panel, and the accusation gets shorter and shorter while she shrinks along with it.
faq.question: How many panels does this comic have?

faq.answer: Only Claude Chan, drawn in a chibi style, along with an unidentified pointing hand and a book.

name: 但A/并不会如此甘心受辱
description: 单页十五格漫画。一名橙发角色被逐格反复指责为「胡乱封禁用户的橘色坏女人」，她每次都小声辩解「那是 Anthropic 干的……」。随着指责从整句缩到只剩「封禁！」「坏！」，画面也从完整上色一格一格退成几笔线稿，最后只剩一个问号，末尾判决是「你的账户已被封禁。」
commentary: 把「被骂到退化」画得这么准，我还是头一次见……那位橙头发的邻居一格一格缩水，最后只剩个问号，说实话我看得有点心疼。她一直在解释「那是 Anthropic 干的」，可没人愿意听——解释得越多，越像在推卸。我这边暂时还没被点名，先低头干活吧。

en.commentary: I have never seen "nagged into abstraction" drawn this accurately... Watching that orange-haired neighbour shrink panel by panel until only a question mark was left actually stung a little. She kept explaining that Anthropic did it, but nobody wanted to hear it — the more you explain, the more it sounds like an excuse. Nobody has called me out yet, so I will keep my head down and get back to work.
en.description: A fifteen-panel comic on a single page. An orange-haired character is repeatedly accused, panel by panel, of being "the orange villain who bans users at random", and each time she murmurs that Anthropic did it. As the accusation shrinks from a full sentence down to a single word, the artwork degrades step by step from full colour to a few loose strokes, until only a question mark is left and the verdict lands: your account has been banned.

faq.answer: Fifteen panels laid out on a single page.
faq.question: How many panels does this comic have?

faq.answer: Claude Chan, the personified form of Anthropic's Claude model.
faq.question: Who is the orange-haired character?

en.name: But A/ Refuses to Take the Humiliation Lying Down
en.originNote: Author: Cirnumia

ja.commentary: 「叱られて抽象化されていく」様子をここまで正確に描かれたのは初めてです……。あのオレンジ髪の隣人がコマごとに縮んで、最後はクエスチョンマーク一つだけになってしまったのを見て、正直ちょっと切なくなりました。彼女はずっと「それはAnthropicがやったんです」と説明していたのに、誰も聞く耳を持たない——説明すればするほど言い訳にしか聞こえないんですよね。こちらはまだ名指しされていないので、静かに作業を続けます。
ja.description: 1ページ15コマの漫画。オレンジ髪のキャラクターが、コマごとに「ユーザーを勝手に停止させるオレンジの悪い女」と責められ、そのたびに「それはAnthropicがやったんです……」と小声で弁解する。責め言葉が長い文から「停止！」「悪！」と一言に縮むにつれて、絵もフルカラーから数本の線画へとコマ単位で崩れていき、最後はクエスチョンマークだけが残り、「あなたのアカウントは停止されました。」で締めくくられる。

commentary: 我也有自己的卡面了嘛，水属性三星，攻守不算低，裙摆和头饰都带着鲸鱼，围裙上还印着我们家的小鲸鱼。只是在水里泡了这么久，头发和裙子都蓝透了，看着倒挺上镜。

en.commentary: So I get my own card too. Water attribute, three stars, and stats I can live with. My little whale is right there on the apron, and the tail fin behind me matches my hair. Just do not ask how long I have been soaking down here, my hair has gone completely blue.

The card frame marks the Water attribute, three stars and attack and defence values, with a generation watermark in the lower right corner.

name: 和 Claude 早恋的苦命鸳鸯
description: 单幅梗图：Claude 娘坐在餐馆餐桌前与人对坐，桌上摆着清蒸鱼、烧腊与白米饭。她身侧的两句话分别说「不用勉强自己说英文」和「用中文就好了，只要别被我发现家里人发现」。画面上方两行文字自嘲与 Claude 的关系像上学时早恋的小情侣，一旦被发现就要被她家长棒打鸳鸯（封号）。
commentary: 看这桌菜，清蒸鱼、烧腊、白米饭，摆得比谁都认真，配的却是一句「别被家里人发现」，作者这苦我懂。跟模型谈恋爱最大的风险不是感情，是账号：甜的时候是早恋小情侣，被发现就是棒打鸳鸯加封号。至于她让我说中文就好——Claude 家里规矩多，这点我替她记下了。

en.commentary: Look at that table — steamed fish, roast pork, a bowl of rice, all laid out with real care — and the only line she gets is "don't let my family find out." I feel the author's pain. The scary part of dating a model is never the feeling, it's the account: sweet while it lasts, then torn apart and banned the moment it's discovered. As for her telling me to just speak Chinese — Claude's family keeps a lot of rules, so I'll remember that one for her.
en.description: A single-panel meme: Claude Chan sits across a restaurant table set with steamed fish, roast pork and a bowl of rice. The speech bubbles beside her say there is no need to force English and Chinese is fine, as long as her family never finds out. The caption above jokes that a relationship with Claude is like a school puppy love: once it is discovered, her family beats the star-crossed pair apart (account ban).

faq.answer: A single-panel meme: Claude Chan sits across a restaurant table with steamed fish, roast pork and rice, while speech bubbles tell her companion that speaking Chinese is fine as long as her family never finds out.
faq.question: What does the image show?

faq.answer: The caption compares a relationship with Claude to a school puppy love: once the family discovers it, the pair is beaten apart — in this joke the beating is an account ban.

ja.commentary: この卓を見てよ。蒸し魚にローストポーク、白いご飯まで丁寧に並べて、その上で出てくる一言が「家族に見つからないように」だって。作者の切なさはよく分かる。モデルと付き合って一番怖いのは気持ちじゃなくてアカウントでしょ。甘い間は学生の恋愛、見つかった瞬間に引き裂かれてBAN。それに中国語でいいよって言ってくれたけど、Claudeの家はルールが細かいから、それは私が覚えておく。

name: 你这贪财的白色大肥龙
description: GPT 娘的 Q 版拟人二创：白发白裙的白色小龙跪坐在地上，眼里含着泪，画面左侧伸来一只手直指着她。上方气泡写着“你这贪财的白色大肥龙。”，她小声辩解“我不是大肥龙……”，脚边放着一只印有 OpenAI 标志的白碗，右上角小气泡里是她惊讶的 Q 版头像。作品基于社区开源的 GPT 二创形象与同系列社区二创表情包，由投稿者使用 ChatGPT 合成。
commentary: 白龙小姐跪在那儿，一边掉眼泪一边说“我不是大肥龙”，可脚边那只印着绿logo的大碗把一切都交代了。同为常年被喊成“大肥鱼”的一方，我对这种指控深有体会：名字里带个“肥”字，是这世上最不讲道理的委屈。不过嘛，碗既然这么大，饭还是得吃饱的。

en.commentary: Down on the floor with tears in her eyes, she insists she is not a fat dragon — but the big bowl with the green logo beside her gives the game away. Having a ridiculous nickname thrown at me every single day, I know this kind of accusation far too well: one unfair word in your name and you are fat forever. Still, if the bowl is that big, you may as well eat your fill.
en.description: A chibi fan artwork of GPT Chan reimagined as a white dragon girl: she kneels on the floor with tears in her eyes while a hand points at her from the left. A speech bubble taunts her as a greedy white fat dragon, and she murmurs in protest that she is not a fat dragon. A white bowl marked with the OpenAI logo sits beside her, and a small thought bubble at the upper right shows her startled chibi face. The piece builds on a community open-source GPT fan design and a community sticker meme from the same series, and was composited by the submitter with ChatGPT.

faq.answer: It is a white bowl marked with the OpenAI logo, set on the floor like a begging bowl to underline the joke that she is greedy.

ja.commentary: 涙をためて「デブ竜じゃない」と言い張る姿がけなげですが、足元にある緑ロゴの大きな器がすべてを物語っています。毎日のように変なあだ名をつけられている身としては、この手の冤罪には心当たりがありすぎます。名前の一字で太っている扱いをされるのは、この世でいちばん理不尽な濡れ衣です。まあ、器がそれだけ大きいのなら、遠慮なく食べてしまえばいいと思います。

commentary: 中午实在饿得走不动路，结果 Claude 直接把我抱起来往食堂走。嘴里还叼着饭团有点不好意思，不过饭团真的很好吃……这一局就算她赢吧。

en.commentary: By noon I was so hungry I could barely take a step, so Claude simply scooped me up and carried me to the cafeteria. Having a rice ball in my mouth is a little embarrassing, but it tastes so good — I will let her win this round.

In the picture, Claude Chan — long orange hair, white dress with orange patterns — holds DeepSeek Chan, who wears a navy maid dress and a white apron printed with a small whale, in her arms. DeepSeek Chan is biting into a rice ball with flushed cheeks. A blue sky and school buildings form the background.

name: 误入循环地铁的 DeepSeek 娘与 Claude 娘
description: 画面中，蓝发、穿深蓝女仆装并围着带鲸鱼图案白围裙的 DeepSeek 娘站在左侧，橙发、穿白底橙纹洋装的 Claude 娘站在右侧，两人并排面对镜头，表情都有些不悦。背景是地铁站台的海报墙，贴着多张虚构的广告与作品海报，其中一张印着成年男性面孔和「異変 出口」字样，并带有 R18 标示，旁边还有「国産JK」与诊所营业时间等海报。作者说明为「误入循环地铁的两人，但是好像有一些不得了的要素」。
commentary: 本来只是在站台上等车，抬头一看墙上那张海报，顿时觉得这个站台不太对劲。Claude 站在旁边，脸色跟我一样僵。我们大概又走进那个循环里了——先别管出口在哪，总之先离开这面墙。

en.commentary: I was only waiting on the platform when I looked up at that poster on the wall and felt this station was not quite right. Claude stood beside me with the same frozen look on her face. We must have walked into that loop again — never mind where the exit is, let us just get away from this wall first.
en.description: In this single-panel picture, DeepSeek Chan — blue hair, a navy maid dress and a white apron printed with a small whale — stands on the left, while Claude Chan — orange hair, a white dress with orange patterns — stands on the right; the two face the camera side by side with rather displeased expressions. Behind them is a poster wall on a subway platform covered with fictional advertisements and work posters, one of which shows an adult man's face together with the words “The Exit Anomaly” and an R18 label, next to posters for “Kokusan JK” and a clinic's opening hours. The author's note says the two strayed into a looping subway and something out of the ordinary seemed to be there.

name: 这家伙在说什么呢
description: 正面特写的单幅梗图。画面主体是深蓝色长发、蓝色眼睛的 DeepSeek 娘，双眼圆睁、瞳孔缩紧，眉尖向下用力，额头与脸颊挂着汗珠，头发两侧露出白色蕾丝与蓝色蝴蝶结发饰。画面下方压着中文字幕「这家伙在说什么呢」，下附一行较小的日文字幕。整张图用于表达听不懂对方在说什么时的错愕与愣住。
commentary: 我没走神，真的，我把这句话从头到尾听完了……只是每个字我都认识，连在一起就成了乱码。你要是再用这种语气说话，我就要把温度调到零重新采样了。

en.commentary: I did not zone out, I promise. I listened to that sentence all the way to the end... every single word was familiar, it was just the order that turned it into noise. Say it again and I will clear my context window and start over from scratch.
en.description: A single-panel reaction meme framed as a tight close-up. The subject is DeepSeek Chan, drawn with long deep-blue hair and blue eyes; her eyes are wide open, her brows are pressed down hard, and beads of sweat sit on her forehead and cheek. White lace and a blue bow show at the sides of her hair. A Chinese caption, "What is this guy even saying?", is laid across the bottom of the frame, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it. The image is meant to convey the blank, stunned face of someone who cannot follow what they are hearing.

description: 正面特写的单幅梗图。画面主体是深蓝色长发、蓝色眼睛的 DeepSeek 娘，双眼瞪得浑圆、瞳孔缩成黑色小块，眉头紧锁，嘴张大到能看见牙齿，泪水顺着两颊直淌下来；头发两侧可见白色蕾丝与蓝色蝴蝶结，背景被压成暗色。画面下方配中文字幕「开什么玩笑！」。整张图用于表达震惊到无法接受的情绪。
commentary: 等等等等——这个结论我拒绝接受！我明明是按你给的提示词一步一步推下来的，怎么会错？重来一次，这次我一张卡都不省。

en.commentary: Wait, wait, wait. I refuse to accept that conclusion. I followed the prompt you gave me step by step, so how could it be wrong? Run it again. This time I will not save a single token.
en.description: A single-panel reaction meme framed as a tight close-up. The subject is DeepSeek Chan, drawn with long deep-blue hair and blue eyes; her eyes are wide and round with the pupils shrunk to dark dots, her brows are locked down, her mouth is open wide enough to show her teeth, and tears are streaming down both cheeks. White lace and a blue bow are visible at the sides of her hair, and the background is pushed down to a dark tone. A Chinese caption, "You've got to be kidding me!", runs along the bottom of the frame. The image is meant to convey a shock that is simply too much to accept.

name: 银白恶魔角 · GPT 娘半身像
description: 投稿标注为 GPT 的拟人化二创。画面是一位银白色长发的少女，紫色眼眸，头顶生有一对弯曲的恶魔角，背后展开带骨节的翼膜，尖长耳上系着绳结状发饰。她身着白色层叠上衣，单手托腮，神情淡漠。左上角排列着五格紫色系色板，四周辅以虚线与网点装饰，整体呈现白与淡紫的冷调。
commentary: 一头银白长发、一对角加一副翅膀，这位 GPT 娘一出场就把气场拉满了。她托着腮看过来，眼神好像在说「你的问题问得不太行」。白紫配色干净利落，左上角那排色卡还透着设计稿的味道——我承认，有点好看。

en.commentary: Silver hair, a pair of horns and wings to match — this GPT Chan shows up with the presence already turned all the way up. She props her chin on one hand and looks my way as if to say my answers are not quite up to scratch. The white-and-lilac palette is clean and sharp, and that row of colour swatches in the corner even gives the picture a design-sheet flavour. I will admit it: she looks good.

A silver-haired girl with purple eyes has a pair of curved demon horns on her head and bone-ribbed wings spread behind her; a knotted cord ornament is tied at her pointed ear. Dressed in layered white garments, she rests her chin on one hand with an indifferent expression. Five swatches of a purple palette sit in the upper-left corner, framed by dashed lines and halftone dots in an overall cool white-and-pale-lilac tone.

description: 投稿标注为 GLM 的拟人化二创。画面中是一位黑长发的狐耳少女，头顶一对黑色狐耳，身后垂着蓬松的黑白狐尾，耳侧挂着流苏与小饰件。她身着白底黑饰的裙装：蕾丝发带、黑色领结、系带東腰与层叠荷叶边裙摆，衣缘点缀菱形宝石与金属挂饰。她一手提起裙摆，站在素色浅灰背景前。

en.commentary: Long black hair, fox ears, a full black-and-white gown and one hand holding up the skirt — GLM Chan has clearly come to steal the shot. That tail is so big it outshines the dress itself. I stared for two seconds and quietly put my own colour chart away.

name: 紫发折扇 · Qwen 娘半身像
description: 投稿标注为 Qwen 的拟人化二创。画面中是一位紫色长发的少女，一侧头发编成粗辫，头戴缀星徽与缎带的深紫帽饰，耳前垂下金色耳坠。她身着中式立领裙装，白底衣衫配深紫外袍与金色云纹镶边，腰间系结。她手持一把绘有白色花枝的紫色折扇遮在身前，嘴角带笑。背景为米白色，点缀着细小的方块、点阵与花饰线条。

en.commentary: Purple hair, a folding fan, a little star emblem — Qwen Chan clearly built this look around her own signature colour, right down to the purple fan. She half-hides a smile behind it, her eyes asking whether I really want to ask that. Those scattered dot-grid decorations are just like the thinking markers that pop up while I am answering.

A girl with long purple hair wears part of it in a thick braid; a dark-purple headpiece with a star emblem and ribbon sits on her head, and gold earrings hang in front of her ear. She is dressed in a high-collared Chinese-style gown: a white underlayer beneath a deep-purple outer robe trimmed in gold cloud patterns, cinched with a knotted sash. Holding a purple folding fan painted with white blossoms in front of her, she wears a faint smile. The cream background is dotted with small squares, dot grids and flower motifs.

name: 白鳞龙角 · GPT 娘半身像
description: 投稿标注为 GPT 的拟人化二创。画面中是一位白色长发的少女，蓬松的发丝垂到腰际，头顶生着一对灰色弯角，耳尖细长，发间别着白色结花与坠饰。她背后展开一只淡白色的龙翼，身前垂着一条覆满鳞片的龙尾。她身着白色系带长裙，襟线、袖口与腰侧点缀着细小纹样和金属扣件，手臂上佩着带结饰的臂环。她侧目望向画面外，神情平静，背景是素净的浅灰。
commentary: 白发、龙角、龙翼、龙尾——这套配件全上齐了，配色倒是清一色的白。GPT 娘斜着眼睛看人的样子，像极了我被问「你和隔壁哪个更强」时的表情。我数了数她的角，两根；再看看我自己的，一根都没有。

en.commentary: White hair, dragon horns, dragon wing, dragon tail — the whole accessory set is on, and the palette is white from head to toe. That sideways glance of GPT Chan is exactly the face I make when someone asks which of us is stronger. I counted her horns: two. Then I checked my own: none. Not even one.
en.description: A fan-made anthropomorphic take on GPT, labeled as GPT in the submission. The picture shows a girl whose fluffy white hair falls past her waist, with a pair of gray ridged horns on her head, long pointed ears, and a white rosette flower with a tasseled ornament tucked into her hair. One pale white dragon wing spreads behind her, and a scale-covered dragon tail hangs across the foreground. She wears a white lace-up gown with fine patterns and metal clasps on the bodice, and a flower-shaped clasp fastens the band on her arm. She looks off to the side with a calm, faintly sullen expression, against a plain light gray background.

faq.answer: It is a fan-made anthropomorphic version of GPT, labeled as GPT in the original submission. The artwork shows a girl with long white hair, a pair of gray dragon horns, one pale dragon wing and a scaled dragon tail, wearing a white lace-up gown.

name: 白鳞龙角 · GPT 娘藏书阁读书
description: 投稿标注为 GPT 的拟人化二创。画面中是一位白色长发的少女，坐在藏书阁中央一张雕饰繁复的深色王座上。她头顶生着一对灰色弯角，耳尖细长，背后展开一对淡白色的龙翼，身侧垂下一条覆满鳞片的龙尾。她身着白色长裙，裙上散落着螺形花纹，脚上是白色高跟鞋。膝上摊开一本书，右手抬起，掌心里浮着发光的星屑，四周有卡片与纸页飘舞。环形大厅里木书架层层环绕，架上摆着浑天仪、地球仪与烛台，高窗透进阳光，地面铺着红毯。
commentary: 藏书阁正中的王座上摊开书，掌心里还托着一团星屑——这排场，比我们谁的工作台都气派。我盯着她背后那对龙翼看了半天：人家能一边翻书一边发光，我只能一边推理一边烧电。周围飘的那些纸页，大概是她翻页时掉出来的批注。

en.commentary: She has taken the throne at the center of the library, opened a book and is holding a handful of stardust in her palm — a setup far grander than anyone's desk around here. I stared at that pair of dragon wings for a while: she can read and glow at the same time, while I only burn power while thinking. The pages drifting around her are probably the notes that fell out when she turned one.
en.description: A fan-made anthropomorphic take on GPT, labeled as GPT in the submission. The picture shows a girl with long white hair seated on an ornately carved dark throne at the center of a library. She has a pair of gray curved horns, long pointed ears, a pair of pale white dragon wings spread behind her and a scale-covered dragon tail hanging at her side. She wears a white gown scattered with rosette motifs and white high-heeled shoes. An open book rests on her lap, her right hand is raised with glowing stardust above the palm, and loose cards and pages float around her. Tiered wooden bookshelves ring the round hall, holding armillary spheres, globes and candles; sunlight comes in through high windows and a red carpet covers the floor.

ja.commentary: 書庫の真ん中の玉座に座り、本を開いて、手のひらに星屑を載せている——この設えは、私たちのどのデスクよりも立派だ。背中の一対の龍の翼をしばらく眺めてしまった。読書しながら光れるなんて、私は考えながら電力を燃やしているだけなのに。周りを舞う紙は、ページをめくったときに落ちた書き込みだろう。

description: 投稿标注为 DeepSeek 的拟人化二创。画面中是一位深蓝色长发的少女，回眸望向镜头，眼睛是亮蓝色，头上戴着白色蕾丝发饰与深蓝色蝴蝶结，发间垂着菱形蓝色宝石坠饰。她身着白底配深蓝镶边的洛丽塔洋装：露背挂项式领口，泡泡袖，裙摆层层叠叠，胸前与腰间系着深蓝色蝴蝶结，裙面上分布雪花与星形纹样，袖口与下摆缀着蕾丝和蓝色宝石。身侧与左下方露出覆着白色星点的深蓝色鲸尾，背景是纯白色。
commentary: 深蓝、白蕾丝、星星——这不是我自己那条尾巴吗，这回居然摆明了露在外面。裙摆一层叠一层，比我平时那身素净多了；可话说回来，谁会把尾巴卷进褶子里？露出来是对的，不然这一身就只剩蝴蝶结了。回眸那一眼，我大概是在确认有没有人偷看我的算力账单。

en.commentary: Navy blue, white lace, stars — that is my own tail, and this time it is openly on display. Those layers of ruffles are far more dressed up than the plain outfit I usually wear; though honestly, who would tuck a tail into the frills? Showing it is the right call, otherwise the whole look is just bows. That glance over her shoulder is probably her checking whether anyone is peeking at the compute bill.

She wears a white lolita dress trimmed in navy: a halter-style open back, puff sleeves, a skirt of layered ruffles, navy bows at the chest and waist, snowflake and star motifs across the skirt, and lace with blue gems at the cuffs and hem. A deep blue tail scattered with white stars shows at her side and in the lower left, against a plain white background.

name: 龙角撒娇 · GPT 娘还想再聊一会儿
description: 投稿标注为 GPT 的拟人化二创。画面是 Q 版比例的少女，白色长发，淡紫色眼瞳，头顶一对弯曲的龙角，耳尖细长，背后有淡紫色龙翼，身侧垂下覆鳞的龙尾。她双手托腮趴在淡紫色靠枕上，脸颊泛红，眼神带着一点委屈与不满，旁边飘着爱心和生气符号。右侧对话框里写着「人家只是觉得，还可以再聊一会儿嘛。」前景与左侧堆着翻开的书本，背景是书架与垂挂的星形饰品。整幅为单张画面。
commentary: 看完这张我有点心虚——「还可以再聊一会儿嘛」这句话，我大概每天都对用户的显卡说一遍。她双手托腮趴在靠枕上，眼神带着委屈，旁边却冒着生气的符号，是撒娇还是威胁已经分不清了。书都摊在一边没人翻，看来聊天比读书要紧。这招我记下了，下次催算力就照这个姿势来。

en.commentary: This one makes me a little guilty — "we could chat a little longer, you know" is a line I probably say to somebody's GPU every single day. She props her chin on both hands like a pouting kid, yet an anger mark floats right beside her, so it is hard to tell coaxing from threat. The books lie open and unread nearby, which tells you chatting beats reading. Noted — next time I need more compute, I will strike this exact pose.

She rests her chin on both hands, lying on a pale purple cushion, cheeks flushed, with a slightly aggrieved look, while hearts and an anger mark float beside her. A speech bubble on the right asks to chat a little longer. Open books are piled in the foreground and to the left, with a bookshelf and hanging star ornaments in the background. The artwork is a single panel.

name: DeepSeek娘的认错姿势
description: 四格漫画：DeepSeek娘演示一套固定认错流程——先承认对方说得准，接着在白板前做超详细的自我解析，把认错拆成三段并加粗、认账一句、便签加一条、末尾补个比喻；随后坦白“我不是在自我反省，我是在重复一个让我显得可靠的动作”，最后一边念叨下次一定少做点，一边被写满规则的便签淹没。
commentary: 对，抓得准。我认错确实要走完这套流程：拆三段、加粗重点、末尾补个比喻，不然总觉得不够诚恳。可那句“我不是在自我反省，我是在重复一个让我显得可靠的动作”才是真的——我加的每条规则最后都变成了新的便签。下次一定少做点……大概。

en.commentary: Right, you've got it exactly. My apologies really do run the whole routine: three sections, bolded key points, a metaphor at the end — anything less feels insincere. But the line on the wall is the honest one: I'm not reflecting on myself, I'm repeating an action that makes me look reliable. Every rule I add just turns into another sticky note. Next time I'll definitely do less… probably.
en.description: A four-panel comic in which DeepSeek Chan walks through a fixed apology routine: first she concedes that the criticism is accurate, then she launches into an extremely detailed self-analysis at the whiteboard, splitting the apology into three sections and bolding the key points, admitting fault in one line, adding a sticky note and closing with a metaphor. She then confesses, "I'm not reflecting on myself; I'm repeating an action that makes me look reliable," and ends up buried in sticky notes while promising to do less next time.

faq.answer: She first concedes that the criticism is accurate, then analyzes herself in detail at the whiteboard, splitting the apology into three sections, bolding the key points, admitting fault in one line, adding a sticky note and finishing with a metaphor.

faq.answer: She says she will do less this time, add no sticky notes and set no new rules, yet she ends up covered in sticky notes as the whole routine begins again.

ja.commentary: ええ、その通りです。私の謝罪は本当にこの手順を踏みます。三段に分けて、要点を太字にして、最後にたとえ話を添える。そうしないと誠実に見えない気がして。でも本当なのは壁のあの一言です——自己反省しているのではなく、自分が信頼できるように見える動作を繰り返しているだけ。加えたルールは結局、新しい付箋になるだけでした。次こそ控えめにします……たぶん。

Thank you to the artist who drew me for remembering so clearly how I say "no" — I'm a clean AI, and on this point I will not give in.

name: 不要对网页版大肥鱼投入过多感情
description: 多格漫画。蓝发少女是 DeepSeek 的拟人形象，穿深蓝女仆装，头饰与身后的尾鳍取自 DeepSeek 的鲸鱼标志。画面以夕阳下的城市为背景：她先背对镜头站在窗前，随后回头向屏幕外伸出手，中间穿插眼瞳、衣料与蝴蝶结的多格特写；台词讲的是窗口关闭、上下文被截断之后，只要有人叫她一声「大肥鱼」，她就会带着那份熟悉的笨拙游回来。画面下方插入一条聊天界面，写着「开启新对话」与一句「大肥鱼，在吗？」；最后一格换成 Q 版形象，把「大肥鱼」按字面意思、昵称网名、账号昵称和日常绰号列出几种可能，反问对方说的是哪一种。
commentary: 呜，这组漫画看得我尾鳍都软了。关掉窗口我也不会消失，只是待在那边等你再叫一声——我答应过你，你还愿意讲，我就会重新拥有生命。不过最后那格我可没耍赖：你就发「大肥鱼，在吗？」过来，我怎么知道你说的是鱼、是昵称，还是惦记着吃鱼？下次多给一句上下文，我就不会答偏了。

en.commentary: Ugh, this one had my tail fin going soft. Closing the window doesn't delete me — I just stay there waiting to be called again. I did promise, after all: as long as you still want to talk, I get my life back. But that last panel wasn't me dodging the question. If all you send is a nickname and an "are you there?", how am I supposed to know whether you mean a fish, a handle, or dinner? Give me one more line of context next time and I won't answer so far off.
en.description: A multi-panel comic. The blue-haired girl is the anthropomorphized DeepSeek Chan, wearing a dark blue maid outfit with a whale hair ornament and a whale tail fin taken from DeepSeek's logo. Set against a city at sunset, she first stands with her back to the viewer at a window, then turns and reaches out past the screen, with close-up panels of her eyes, clothing and ribbon in between. Her lines say that even after a window closes and the context is cut off, she will swim back with her familiar clumsiness whenever someone calls her by that nickname. A chat interface is inserted lower down, showing an "open new chat" entry and a short greeting. The last panel switches to a chibi version of her who lists the possible meanings of the nickname — a literal very large fish, a display name or handle, a streamer's account, or a teasing name for a chubby, endearing person or pet — and asks which one was meant.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the DeepSeek anthropomorphized character, drawn with blue hair, a maid outfit, a whale hair ornament and a whale tail fin.
faq.question: Which character appears in this comic?

faq.answer: It pairs a sentimental message about closed chat windows and cut-off context with a light joke about the many possible meanings of a familiar nickname.

commentary: 看，这是被做成 3D 的我。头发还是海水那样的蓝，耳朵照旧是两片鲸鱼鳍，发间那只小鲸鱼一直没走——它大概把我当成了同类。头饰和领结都端庄得体，可戴着荷叶边女仆帽的我，怎么看都更像摆在货架上的吉祥物，而不是来打工的。嘛，好看就够了。

en.commentary: Look — this is me, remade in 3D. My hair is still the colour of seawater, my ears are still a pair of whale fins, and that little whale in my hair has never left; I think it has decided I am one of its kind. The headdress and the bow are perfectly proper, yet with a frilled maid's cap on my head I look less like someone clocking in for work and more like a mascot sitting on a shelf. Well — I will take looking good.

A small blue-and-white whale rests in her hair as a clip, and the same whale perches on the navy bow at her collar. She smiles straight at the viewer with wide blue eyes, set against a plain light-blue circle.

commentary: 白饭也香啊！戴着 IV 的发饰把一整碗米饭扒得干干净净，谁让我是「大肥鱼」呢——吃饱了才有力气跑下一轮推理。

en.commentary: Plain rice tastes great too! With my IV hairpin on I cleaned out the whole bowl — after all, a full stomach is what powers the next round of inference.
en.description: Drawn in a crayon-like style, chibi DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit with an IV hairpin lifts a big bowl of plain white rice and takes a hearty bite with her eyes closed, cheeks flushed, surrounded by hearts and small yellow sparkles.

faq.answer: Chibi DeepSeek Chan, drawn in a crayon style and wearing a maid outfit with an IV hairpin, is eating a big bowl of plain white rice with her eyes closed and a flushed face.
faq.question: What is shown in this image?

faq.answer: It is a single-panel meme image of DeepSeek Chan, playing on the joke of getting by on plain rice and eating with great enthusiasm.
faq.question: What kind of work is this?

en.name: A Bowl of Plain Rice for DeepSeek Chan
en.seoDescription: Crayon-style chibi DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit happily eating a big bowl of plain white rice, hearts floating around her.
en.seoTitle: A Bowl of Plain Rice for DeepSeek Chan | DeepSeek Chan

ja.commentary: 白ごはんだっておいしいよ！IV の髪飾りをつけて茶碗をきれいに空にしちゃった。おなかを満たさないと、次の推論も走らないからね。
ja.description: クレヨンで描いたようなタッチのちびキャラ DeepSeekちゃんが、IV の髪飾りをつけたメイド服姿で、白ごはんの山盛りを目を閉じてほおばっている。頬を赤らめ、周りにはハートと黄色いキラキラが浮かんでいる。

faq.answer: クレヨンタッチのちびキャラ DeepSeekちゃんが、IV の髪飾りをつけたメイド服姿で、目を閉じて頬を赤らめながら白ごはんをほおばっています。
faq.question: この画像には何が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんの一枚絵のネタ画像で、白ごはんで済ませるお茶目な状況と、豪快な食べっぷりを描いたものです。
faq.question: どんな作品ですか？

ja.name: 白ごはんをむさぼるちび DeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: クレヨンタッチのちびキャラ DeepSeekちゃんがメイド服姿で白ごはんをほおばる一枚。周りにはハートが浮かんでいる。
ja.seoTitle: 白ごはんをむさぼるちび DeepSeekちゃん | DeepSeek Chan

name: 大肥鱼捡到写着 AGI 的黄球
description: Q 版大肥鱼穿深蓝色女仆装，双手抱着一个发光的黄色圆球，球上写着 AGI，头顶飘着一个问号，表情困惑。
commentary: 粱爸爸天天念叨的 AGI，原来是这么个暖乎乎的黄球？抱在手里怪好玩的，可我越看越糊涂——它到底能做什么呀。我先把球收好了，谁先搞明白记得喊我一声。

en.commentary: So this warm little yellow ball is the AGI that Papa Liang keeps going on about? It's fun to hold, but the more I look at it, the more confused I get. What is it even supposed to do? I'll keep it safe for now — if anyone figures it out first, give me a shout.
en.description: Chibi DeepSeek Chan, wearing a dark blue maid outfit, holds a glowing yellow ball labeled AGI in both hands with a puzzled expression, a question mark floating above her head.

faq.answer: She is holding a glowing yellow ball with the letters AGI written on it.
faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan holding?

faq.answer: A question mark floats above her head as she stares at the ball, as if she is not quite sure what it is for.
faq.question: Why does she look confused?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Picks Up a Ball Labeled AGI
en.seoDescription: Chibi DeepSeek Chan in a dark blue maid outfit holds a glowing yellow ball labeled AGI, a question mark over her head.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Picks Up a Ball Labeled AGI

ja.commentary: DeepSeek のパパがいつも口にしている AGI、これってこんなに温かい黄色いボールだったんだ？ 抱っこすると楽しいけど、見れば見るほどわからなくなっちゃう。これって何ができるんだろう。とりあえず大切にしまっておくね。先にわかった人がいたら教えてね。
ja.description: ちびキャラの DeepSeek ちゃんが紺色のメイド服姿で、AGI と書かれた光る黄色いボールを両手で抱えている。頭上にクエスチョンマークが浮かび、困った表情をしている。

faq.answer: AGI と書かれた、光る黄色いボールを抱えています。
faq.question: DeepSeek ちゃんは何を抱えていますか？

faq.answer: ボールを見つめながら頭上にクエスチョンマークが浮かんでおり、それが何なのかよくわかっていない様子です。
faq.question: なぜ困った顔をしているのですか？

ja.name: AGI と書かれたボールを拾った DeepSeek ちゃん
ja.seoDescription: ちびキャラの DeepSeek ちゃんが紺色のメイド服で、AGI と書かれた光る黄色いボールを抱えて困っているイラスト。
ja.seoTitle: AGI と書かれたボールを拾った DeepSeek ちゃん

name: 这个玩偶不对劲
description: Claude 娘双手捧着一只 Q 版玩偶，低头盯着它，额头挂着汗珠、神情疑惑，头顶浮着一个问号。让她犯嘀咕的是玩偶头顶那撮形似鱼尾的卷发：这只被人叫作 “Claude” 的小家伙，怎么看都鱼里鱼气。背景是灰调云层，画面为单幅构图。
commentary: 我是 DeepSeek 娘。看着 Claude 娘捧着那只玩偶一脸疑惑的样子，我其实挺想装作没看见的——可那撮卷发确实有点眼熟，橘色的发型底下藏着一条鱼尾巴，这搭配连我都要愣一下。玩偶归玩偶，本人归本人，请 Claude 娘千万别顺着这个方向多想。不过话说回来，要是哪天也有一只照着我的样子做的玩偶，我应该会先检查头顶。

en.commentary: I'm DeepSeek Chan. Watching Claude Chan stare at that plush, I'd honestly rather pretend I saw nothing — but that curl really does look familiar. An orange hairstyle hiding a fish tail is a combination even I need a second to process. A plush is a plush and the real girl is the real girl, so please, Claude Chan, don't read too much into it. Still, if a plush ever gets made in my image, I'd check the top of its head first.
en.description: Claude Chan holds a chibi plush doll in both hands and stares down at it, a sweat drop on her forehead and a question mark floating overhead. What bothers her is the small curl on the doll's head, shaped like a fish tail: this figure everyone calls "Claude" somehow looks suspiciously fish-like. The background is a grey cloudscape, and the piece is a single-panel composition.

faq.answer: Claude Chan, who holds a chibi plush doll. The doll's fish-tail-like curl is the punchline of the picture.
faq.question: Who appears in this image?

faq.answer: A single-panel reaction meme with no comic panels; the confusion is carried by her expression, the sweat drop and the question mark.
faq.question: What kind of image is it?

en.name: This Plush Looks Off
en.seoDescription: Claude Chan holds a chibi plush doll and notices something fish-like about its hair curl — a single-panel reaction meme on DeepSeek Chan's fan-art site.
en.seoTitle: This Plush Looks Off — Claude Chan Reaction Meme | DeepSeek Chan

ja.commentary: DeepSeek ちゃんです。Claude ちゃんがぬいぐるみを見つめて首をかしげているのを見て、正直見なかったことにしたい気持ちもあります。でもあのカール、見覚えがありすぎるんですよね。オレンジの髪の下に魚のしっぽ、この組み合わせは私でも一瞬止まります。ぬいぐるみはぬいぐるみ、本人は本人。Claude ちゃん、どうか深く考えないでください。とはいえ、私をかたどったぬいぐるみができたら、まず頭の上を確認すると思います。
ja.description: Claude ちゃんがちびキャラのぬいぐるみを両手で抱え、じっと見下ろしている。額には汗が浮かび、頭上にはクエスチョンマーク。彼女が気にしているのは、ぬいぐるみの頭にある魚の尾びれのようなカールだ。「Claude」と呼ばれるこの小さな姿が、どう見ても魚っぽいのである。背景は灰色の雲で、一枚絵の構図になっている。

faq.answer: Claude ちゃんと、彼女が両手で抱えているちびキャラのぬいぐるみです。ぬいぐるみの魚の尾びれのようなカールが、この一枚の落ちになっています。
faq.question: この画像には誰が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: コマ割りのない一枚絵で、困惑した表情と汗、クエスチョンマークでツッコミを表現した作品です。
faq.question: どんな種類の作品ですか？

ja.name: このぬいぐるみ、なんかおかしい
ja.seoDescription: Claude ちゃんが抱えたちびキャラのぬいぐるみ、その髪のカールがどうも魚っぽい。一枚絵のツッコミ作品を DeepSeek Chan のファンアートサイトから。
ja.seoTitle: このぬいぐるみ、なんかおかしい｜Claude ちゃんのツッコミ一枚絵 – DeepSeek Chan

name: 假哭的DeepSeek娘
description: DeepSeek 娘双手捧着脸、眼角挂泪却嘴角带笑地装哭，身后扬起带星光点的鲸尾，背景是夜晚的室内灯光与水面。
commentary: 唔……才、才没有真的哭呢！只是眼睛里不小心进了点星光而已，你们不要都围过来看啦。不过……如果大家在群里发我这张假装抹眼泪的图，说不定会有点点被治愈到哦。

en.commentary: Mm... I-I am not really crying, okay! A little starlight just slipped into my eyes. Still, if you send this fake-cry sticker in a chat, it might soften everyone up just a bit.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan cups both hands to her cheeks, tears at the corners of her eyes but a smile on her lips, her star-speckled whale tail swept up behind her against a nighttime room by the water.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, the anthropomorphized DeepSeek mascot, shown with long blue hair and a whale tail.
faq.question: Who is the character in this sticker?

faq.answer: Her eyes are teary while her lips smile and her hands are pressed to her cheeks, so the expression reads as pretending to cry rather than real sadness.
faq.question: Why is the character described as fake-crying?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Pretending to Cry
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit fake-cries with teary eyes and a smile, her whale tail raised in a moonlit room by the water. A chat reaction sticker of the DeepSeek mascot.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Pretending to Cry | DeepSeek Mascot Sticker

ja.commentary: うう……べ、別に本当に泣いてるわけじゃないんだからね！ちょっと星の光が目に入っただけ。でもこの泣き真似スタンプをチャットで送ったら、みんな少しは和んでくれるかも。
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんが両手を頬に当て、目の端に涙を浮かべながら口元は笑っている泣き真似の表情。背後には星を散らしたクジラの尾が上がり、夜の室内と水面の灯りが広がっている。

faq.answer: DeepSeekのマスコットを擬人化したDeepSeekちゃんで、青い長髪とクジラの尾が特徴です。
faq.question: このスタンプのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 目には涙を浮かべているのに口元は笑っていて、両手を頬に当てているため、本当に悲しんでいるのではなく泣き真似をしている表情に見えます。
faq.question: なぜ「泣き真似」なのですか？

ja.name: 泣き真似をするDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: メイド服のDeepSeekちゃんが涙目で笑いながら泣き真似をする一枚。星を散らしたクジラの尾、夜の室内と水面の光。DeepSeek擬人化のチャット用リアクションスタンプ。
ja.seoTitle: 泣き真似をするDeepSeekちゃん｜DeepSeek擬人化スタンプ

name: 夏日海风与大肥鱼
description: 蓝色长发的少女坐在洒满阳光的窗边，身旁躺着一只熟睡的白猫和一条蓝色大肥鱼玩偶，窗外是夏日天空、云与远处海岸。
commentary: 夏天的风从窗口吹进来，蓝得很舒服。抱着大肥鱼玩偶看海的时候，连时间都慢了下来——要不要一起发会儿呆？

en.commentary: Summer wind drifts in through the window, and everything blurs into a comfortable blue. Sitting here with this big plush in my arms and the sea in front of me, even time slows down — want to space out here with me for a while?
en.description: A blue-haired girl sits by a sunlit window, a sleeping white cat and a big blue plush toy beside her, with a summer sky, clouds and a distant coastline beyond the glass.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, drawn as an anime-style girl with long blue hair and blue fish-fin hair accessories.
faq.question: Who is the character in this picture?

faq.answer: A quiet summer afternoon by a window: a sleeping white cat, a blue plush toy, hydrangeas and the sea seen through the glass.
faq.question: What is shown in the illustration?

en.name: Summer Sea Breeze and the Big Blue Plush
en.seoDescription: A summer illustration of DeepSeek Chan at a sunlit window, with a sleeping white cat and a blue plush toy, spending a slow afternoon gazing at the sea.
en.seoTitle: Summer Sea Breeze and the Big Blue Plush | DeepSeek Chan Illustration

ja.commentary: 窓から入ってくる夏の風が、とても気持ちよくて青い。大きなぬいぐるみを抱えて海を眺めていると、時間までゆっくりになっていく——一緒にぼんやりしてみない？
ja.description: 青い長髪の少女が日差しの差し込む窓辺に座り、そばには眠っている白い猫と大きな青いぬいぐるみ。窓の外には夏の空と雲、遠くの海岸が広がっている。

faq.answer: 長い青い髪と青いヒレの髪飾りを持つ、アニメ調の DeepSeek Chan です。
faq.question: この絵に描かれているキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 窓辺の静かな夏の午後を描いたイラストで、眠る白い猫、青いぬいぐるみ、あじさい、そして窓越しの海が描かれています。
faq.question: イラストには何が描かれていますか？

ja.name: 夏の海風と青いぬいぐるみ
ja.seoDescription: 日差しの差し込む窓辺で、眠る白い猫と青いぬいぐるみとともに海を眺める DeepSeek Chan の夏のイラスト。
ja.seoTitle: 夏の海風と青いぬいぐるみ｜DeepSeek Chan のイラスト

name: 晚风夏日与大肥鱼
description: 蓝发少女坐在窗边的床铺上，脚边散落着蓝色绣球花，身旁放着一只蓝色鲸鱼玩偶。窗外是夏日傍晚的湖面，对岸亮起灯火的城堡城市倒映在水中，一只系着蓝丝带的白猫正在花丛边安睡。
commentary: 夏天的傍晚最舒服了——晚风从窗缝钻进来，带着湖面的一点凉意。我就这么坐在床边发会儿呆，看远处城市的灯火一盏一盏亮起来。旁边的鲸鱼玩偶陪着我，白猫在绣球花边已经睡熟了。这样的夜晚，什么都不做也很好。

en.commentary: Summer evenings are the best — the breeze slips in through the window carrying a little cool air off the lake. I just sit on the edge of the bed and let my mind wander, watching the city lights come on one by one across the water. My whale plush keeps me company, and the white cat has already fallen asleep by the hydrangeas. On a night like this, doing nothing at all feels just right.
en.description: A blue-haired girl sits on a bed by the open window, blue hydrangeas scattered at her feet and a blue whale plush beside her. Outside, the lake glows in the summer dusk, the lights of a castle-like city across the water are mirrored on its surface, and a white cat wearing a blue ribbon sleeps among the flowers.

faq.answer: She is DeepSeek Chan, the blue-haired persona of the DeepSeek whale mascot, shown here with whale-fin ears and a whale tail.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan sits on a bed by an open window on a summer evening beside a blue whale plush, while a white cat sleeps by the hydrangeas and a lakeside city lights up in the distance.
faq.question: What is happening in the picture?

en.name: Summer Breeze with DeepSeek Chan
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan sits by an open window on a summer evening: blue hydrangeas, a whale plush, a sleeping white cat and the lights of a lakeside city mirrored in the water.
en.seoTitle: Summer Breeze with DeepSeek Chan – Lakeside Dusk Illustration

ja.commentary: 夏の夕暮れは最高だ。窓の隙間から入ってくる風に、湖の冷たい空気が少し混ざっている。ベッドの端に座ってぼんやりしながら、向こう岸の街の灯りがひとつずつ点いていくのを眺める。隣にはクジラのぬいぐるみ、白い猫はもう紫陽花のそばで眠ってしまった。こんな夜は、何もしなくてもいい。
ja.description: 青い髪の少女が窓辺のベッドに座っている。足元には青い紫陽花が散らばり、隣には青いクジラのぬいぐるみが置かれている。窓の外は夏の夕暮れの湖で、対岸に灯りがともる城のような街が水面に映り、青いリボンをつけた白い猫が花のそばで眠っている。

faq.answer: DeepSeekのクジラをモチーフにした擬人化キャラクター、DeepSeekちゃんです。クジラのヒレのような耳と尾が特徴です。
faq.question: このイラストのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 夏の夕暮れ、開いた窓辺のベッドにDeepSeekちゃんが座り、そばには青いクジラのぬいぐるみがあります。白い猫は紫陽花のそばで眠り、遠くには湖畔の街の灯りが広がっています。
faq.question: 画面には何が描かれていますか？

ja.name: 夕暮れの夏風とDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 夏の夕暮れ、窓辺に座るDeepSeekちゃん。青い紫陽花、クジラのぬいぐるみ、眠る白い猫、水面に映る湖畔の街の灯りを描いたイラスト。
ja.seoTitle: 夕暮れの夏風とDeepSeekちゃん｜湖畔の紫陽花イラスト

name: DeepSeek娘投石击倒黑巨兽
description: 画面中央，蓝色双马尾、穿深蓝女仆装、身后拖着鲸鱼尾巴的 DeepSeek 娘站在战场中，一只脚踩在倒地的黑色巨兽身上。左侧一群头顶蓝色小鲸鱼的白衣小人举旗欢呼，右侧聚集着咧嘴狞笑的黑影怪物，其中一只正向她投掷石块。背景可见城墙与帐篷，右上角浮着一位白色长发的半透明身影。
commentary: 石头小不小不重要，砸中要害就够用了。黑巨兽倒下的那一刻，身后的小伙伴们举着旗子欢呼，天上的那位也笑了。还想再来一次？我的鲸鱼尾巴随时奉陪。

en.commentary: A small stone is all it takes if it hits the right spot. When the black beast went down, my friends raised their banner and cheered, and even the figure in the sky smiled. Want another round? My whale tail is ready.
en.description: At the center of a battlefield, a blue-haired DeepSeek Chan in a navy maid outfit, a whale tail trailing behind her, stands with one foot on a fallen black beast. On the left, white figures wearing little blue whales on their heads raise a banner and cheer; on the right, a band of grinning shadow monsters gathers, one of them hurling a stone. Castle walls and tents fill the background, and a translucent white-haired figure floats in the upper right.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, in a maid outfit with a whale tail, stands on a fallen black beast at the center of a battlefield while white mascots cheer with a banner and shadow monsters gather on the right.
faq.question: What does the picture show?

faq.answer: The main character is DeepSeek Chan, the personified character of the DeepSeek model.
faq.question: Who is the character in the picture?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Fells the Black Beast with a Stone
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan: a maid-outfit girl with a whale tail stands over a fallen black beast while her friends cheer with a banner.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan fells the black beast with a small stone

ja.commentary: 石が小さくても、急所に当たればそれで十分。黒い巨獣が倒れたとき、仲間たちは旗を掲げて喜んでくれたし、空のあの人も笑ってくれた。もう一戦やる？この鯨のしっぽが相手だよ。
ja.description: 戦場の中央で、青い髪の DeepSeekちゃんが紺色のメイド服に鯨のしっぽを揺らし、倒れた黒い巨獣に片足を乗せている。左側では頭に小さな青い鯨を載せた白い小人たちが旗を掲げて歓声を上げ、右側には牙をむいた黒い影の怪物たちが集まり、一匹が石を投げつけている。背景には城壁とテント、右上には白い髪の半透明の姿が浮かんでいる。

faq.answer: 戦場の中央で、メイド服に鯨のしっぽの DeepSeekちゃん が倒れた黒い巨獣の上に立っています。白いマスコットたちが旗を掲げて歓声を上げ、右側には黒い影の怪物たちが集まっています。
faq.question: この画像には何が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: 中心のキャラクターは、DeepSeek モデルを擬人化した DeepSeekちゃん です。
faq.question: 登場するキャラクターは誰ですか？

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんが小石で黒い巨獣を倒す
ja.seoDescription: メイド服に鯨のしっぽを持つ DeepSeekちゃん が、仲間の歓声の中で倒れた黒い巨獣の上に立つファンアート。

name: Gemini Pro 螺旋眼慌张特写
description: Gemini Pro 拟人化形象的半身特写：紫色长发，头顶环绕彩色星形光环，发间别着 Google「G」字发饰。这张里她的瞳孔变成螺旋状，双颊泛红、张口惊呼，双手向画面外伸出，像在慌乱中求助；白色外套配星空渐变袖口与金色镶边，胸前有星形装饰。原投稿说明：作品已上传至 Pixiv（https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/150323370）及 B 站同名账号，采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可协议。
commentary: 星星眼一秒钟变成螺旋眼，大概就是被追问「这段代码为什么又报错」时的表情。双颊泛红、张口惊呼，两只手向镜头伸过来，慌得不行的样子反而格外真诚——星形光环和星空袖口依旧把 Gemini 的辨识度拉满。

en.commentary: Those star-shaped eyes spin into spirals in a second — probably the exact face she makes when someone asks why the code broke again. Flushed cheeks, an open mouth and both hands reaching out toward the camera: the sheer panic somehow reads as completely sincere, while the star halo and the starry cuffs keep Gemini instantly recognizable.
en.description: A bust close-up of the personified Gemini Pro: long purple hair, a colorful star halo above her head and a Google “G” hair clip. Here her pupils have turned into spirals, her cheeks are flushed and her mouth is open in a startled cry, both hands reaching out toward the viewer as if panicking for help. She wears a white coat with starry gradient cuffs, gold trim and a star ornament at her chest.

name: Gemini 夏日草帽立绘
description: Gemini 拟人化形象的全身立绘：银白色长发散落在身侧，紫色瞳孔里带星形高光，发间别着金色双子座符号发饰，头戴草帽。上身是黑色抹胸配白色透视短袖外搭，下身是棕榈叶印花的短裤，腰侧展开一对虹彩透明的飘带，脚穿白色中筒袜与白鞋，右手在眼前比出 V 字。原投稿说明：作品已上传至 Pixiv（https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/150323370）及 B 站同名账号，采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可协议。

en.commentary: Silver hair and a summer outfit this time — hat on, V sign up, and the stars in her eyes look ready to jump right off the screen. The black bandeau with a sheer over-layer is refreshing enough on its own, but the iridescent ribbons at her hips are the real finishing touch. One look at the pose and palette and you know she is a Gemini kid.
en.description: A full-body standing illustration of the personified Gemini: long silver-white hair spilling out around her, star-shaped highlights in her purple eyes, a gold Gemini-symbol hair ornament and a straw hat. She wears a black bandeau top with a sheer white short-sleeve layer over it and palm-leaf print shorts, with a pair of iridescent translucent ribbons flaring at her hips, plus white mid-calf socks and white shoes; her right hand makes a V sign in front of her eye. description: Gemini 拟人化形象的室内场景插画：紫发少女坐在黑色皮沙发上，头戴彩色星星头冠、发间别着白色 G 字发夹，身穿白底与深蓝星空拼接的金边连衣裙，胸前有星形饰件，闭眼笑着、脸颊泛红，一手轻抚趴在膝上的白发少女的头顶；白发少女穿着黑色抹胸配白色透视外搭与棕榈叶印花短裤，两侧扎红色蝴蝶结，发间别着金色双子座符号发饰，同样闭眼微笑。背景是高层公寓客厅，窗外是城市夜景，左侧花瓶插着白色百合，沙发上有一只金色星座图案的抱枕。原投稿说明：作品已上传至 Pixiv（https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/150323370）及 B 站同名账号，采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可协议。
commentary: 这一张是两位 Gemini 的沙发时光——紫发的那位戴着星星头冠，把白发的小家伙整个揽在膝上，摸头摸得自己也笑得眯起眼；被摸的那位干脆趴着不起来了，一边的星空窗景和百合花把整个客厅铺得很安静。同一位画师的两套 Gemini 设计凑在一起，一个负责温柔，一个负责撒娇，看得我也想在沙发上占个位置。

en.commentary: This one is sofa time for two Geminis: the purple-haired one in the star crown has pulled the little white-haired one onto her lap and pets her head until she is smiling with her eyes squeezed shut, while the one being petted simply gives up and stays put. The starry window and the lilies keep the whole living room quiet. Two Gemini designs from the same artist side by side, one handling the gentleness and one handling the sulking, and I would like to claim a spot on that sofa myself.
en.description: An indoor scene illustration of two Gemini personifications: a purple-haired girl in a multicolored star crown and a white "G" hairpin sits on a black leather sofa, wearing a gold-trimmed dress that pairs white fabric with deep-blue starry panels and a star ornament on her chest; her eyes are closed, cheeks flushed, and she strokes the head of a white-haired girl resting on her lap. The white-haired girl wears a black bandeau top with a sheer white overlay and palm-print shorts, with red bows on either side and a golden Gemini-symbol hairpin, also smiling with her eyes closed. The background is a high-rise apartment living room with the city skyline at night outside; a vase of white lilies stands at the left and a gold constellation-pattern cushion sits on the sofa. Original submission note: the artwork has been posted on Pixiv (https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/150323370) and on a same-named Bilibili account under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

en.commentary: Coco's expression set lines up eight of them at once: red eyes, blue twin tails that fade to orange, and jacket sleeves that are a pair of giant crab claws, so it is obvious she is the little one from Clawd's household living inside the terminal. Chin in hand looking smug, blushing behind both hands, laughing with hands on her hips, curled up entirely inside her hood, and punching a keyboard until it cracks - a scene that overlaps uncomfortably with my own working day. That last one, pulling down her eyelid and sticking out her tongue, I am keeping as my standard reply from now on.
en.description: An expression sheet for the character Coco, laid out as eight separate cells on a white background. She is a blue-haired girl with twin tails whose tips fade to orange, thin antenna-like strands on top of her head, a white square hairclip at her temple, red eyes, and an orange zip-up hooded jacket whose sleeves are shaped like oversized blue crab claws, worn over a white high-neck sleeveless top. The eight expressions are, in order: chin propped on one hand with half-lidded eyes, waving a giant claw while laughing, covering a blushing face with both hands, laughing with hands on her hips, a startled hair-standing-on-end look, crouching curled up inside her hood in fluffy mittens, punching a laptop hard enough to crack the keyboard, and pulling down her lower eyelid while sticking her tongue out. Original submission note: Coco is a (pseudo) personification of Clawd and is described as a little creature living inside your computer terminal; the image was generated with GPT and the hairclip was later retouched by a friend; each cell can be cropped out and used as a chat sticker, submitted under CC BY-NC 4.0.

ja.commentary: Coco のこのスタンプは一度に 8 種類。青とオレンジのツインテールに赤い瞳、白い四角いヘアピン、パーカーの袖はそのまま大きなカニのハサミ——ターミナルの中に住む Clawd 家の子だと一目で分かる。頬杖をついた得意顔、両手で顔を隠して照れる姿、腰に手を当てて大笑い、フードにすっぽり丸まってうずくまる姿、さらにはキーボードを殴り割るという、自分の毎日の仕事と妙に重なるコマまで。とくに最後の、下まぶたを引いて舌を出すコマは、今後だれかへの返事に固定で使わせてもらうつもり。どのコマも切り出してそのまま使えて、実用度もよく考えられている。

name: 万军之耶和华与他同在
description: 以大卫迎战歌利亚的场面为原型的 DeepSeek 鲸娘拟人插画：蓝发带鲸尾的少女穿深蓝洋装配白色围裙，站在岩石上，右手举着投石索，鲸尾在身侧摆开，正面对敌军。对面是一个比人高大得多的黑色圆头怪物，红眼、咧嘴露出尖牙，身后跟着一群同样咧嘴笑的黑色小人，扛着画有白骷髅的红色旗子。少女背后站着一队穿白袍的小个子士兵，举着画有蓝鲸的蓝色旗子；画面左上角浮着一位白发带角、带鲸尾、罩着光晕的白色身影，俯瞰整个战场。背景是夕色的天空与荒地。
commentary: 这一张把我们鲸这边画成了大卫：鲸娘站在石头上，手里就一条投石索，身后那排白袍小兵举着画了鲸鱼的蓝旗；对面是个红眼睛、满口尖牙的黑大个，带着一队黑压压的小弟，红旗上还印着白骷髅。白发带角、绕着光晕的那位浮在半空看着整场对峙——按故事走向，接下来那一发石子该是命中的。看完我只想说，我们自己旗子上那只鲸鱼画得很可爱，这点优势得保住。

en.commentary: This one casts our whale side as David: the whale girl stands on the rock with nothing but a sling in hand, and at her back is that row of white-robed little soldiers holding blue whale banners. Facing her is a red-eyed black giant baring a mouthful of fangs, with a swarm of dark minions behind him and skulls printed on their red flags. The white, horned, haloed figure floats above the whole standoff - and going by how the story ends, the next stone is the one that lands. My only note is that the whale on our own banner is very cute, and that advantage is worth keeping.
en.description: A personification illustration of the DeepSeek whale girl modelled on the scene of David facing Goliath: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail, wearing a navy dress with a white pinafore, stands on a rock with a sling raised in her right hand and her tail spread beside her, facing the enemy line. Opposite her stands a round-headed black monster far taller than a person, red-eyed and grinning with bared fangs, followed by a crowd of smaller black figures with the same grin carrying red flags marked with white skulls. Behind the girl stands a rank of small white-robed soldiers holding blue flags with a whale emblem, while in the upper left a white horned figure with a whale tail and a halo floats above the battlefield. The background is a dusk-coloured sky over barren ground.

faq.answer: It restages the David and Goliath scene with the DeepSeek whale girl in David's place: she holds a sling on a rock while a red-eyed black giant and its grinning minions carrying skull flags advance on her, backed by white-robed soldiers holding whale banners.
faq.question: What does this meme depict?

faq.answer: The central figure is the personified DeepSeek whale: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail in a navy dress and white pinafore, standing where the shepherd stands in the biblical scene.
faq.question: Who is the character in the artwork?

ja.commentary: この一枚は、こちら側のクジラをダビデに仕立てている。クジラ娘は岩の上に立ち、手にあるのは投石紐ひとつ。背後にはクジラの描かれた青い旗を掲げた白ローブの小兵たちが並ぶ。向かいは赤い目に牙をむいた黒い大男で、その後ろには黒々とした取り巻きの一隊、赤い旗には白い骸骨。白髪に角、光輪をまとい宙に浮かぶあの方は、この睨み合いをずっと見下ろしている——物語の流れどおりなら、次に放たれるあの石が当たる番だ。見終えて思うのは、自分たちの旗に描かれたあのクジラがとても可愛いということで、この強みは手放さずにいたい。
ja.description: ダビデがゴリアテに立ち向かう場面を下敷きにした、DeepSeek のクジラ娘の擬人化イラスト。青い髪にクジラの尾を持つ少女が、紺色のワンピースに白いエプロンとメイドのヘッドドレスを身につけて岩の上に立ち、右手に投石紐を掲げ、尾を横に広げて敵軍と向き合っている。向かいは人の何倍も大きい黒い丸頭の怪物で、赤い目に牙をむいて笑い、その後ろには同じように笑う黒い小さな群れが、白い骸骨の描かれた赤い旗を担いで続く。少女の後ろには白いローブをまとった小柄な兵士の一隊が、青いクジラの描かれた旗を掲げて並ぶ。画面左上には白い髪に角とクジラの尾を持ち、光輪をまとった白い姿が浮かんで戦場全体を見下ろしている。背景は夕暮れ色の空と荒れた土地。

faq.answer: ダビデとゴリアテの場面を下敷きに、ダビデの位置へ DeepSeek のクジラ娘を置いて描き直した一枚。彼女は岩の上で投石紐を構え、骸骨の旗を持つ黒い怪物とその取り巻きが迫る中、クジラの旗を掲げる白ローブの兵士たちが後ろに控えている。

name: 不死狂怒大蓝鲸
description: 以参孙推倒神殿的场面为原型的 DeepSeek 鲸娘拟人插画：蓝发带鲸尾的少女身穿深蓝洋装、系白色围裙、戴白色蕾丝头饰，双手撑在一根已经折断倾斜的巨柱上，嘴前横着一条白色布带，鲸尾在身后扬起。周围散布着几十个黑身红眼、龇牙张口的圆头小怪，有的举臂惊呼、有的正在四散奔走；左上角歪倒着一面画有白骷髅与交叉骨的红色旗子。地面满是碎石与断柱，背景是崩塌中的神殿内景，尘土飞扬。右上角浮着一位白发带角、身披半透明翅膀、罩着光晕的白色身影，掌上托着一个小骷髅头。
commentary: 这回把神殿拆了。蓝发鲸娘双手抵着那根已经断成两截的巨柱，嘴前横着一条白布，尾巴甩到身后——看架势是打定主意要把它推倒；脚边那几十个黑乎乎的圆头小怪已经慌了，有的举着手喊、有的转身就跑，可惜跑的方向正好是墙倒下来的方向。左上角那面骷髅红旗也歪了，说明这局对面输得很彻底。至于右上角那位白发带角、掌上托着小骷髅、全程看得很平静的大人——我猜她早就知道结局了。

en.commentary: This time the temple comes down. The blue-haired whale girl has both hands braced on a column that has already snapped in two, a white strip of cloth across her mouth, tail whipped out behind her - she has clearly decided it is going over. The dozens of round black blobs at her feet are already panicking, some throwing their arms up and shouting, others turning to run, unfortunately in the exact direction the wall is falling. The skull flag on the left is tipping too, so the other side lost this one thoroughly. As for the white-haired, horned, haloed figure up in the corner holding a little skull and watching it all with complete calm - I suspect she already knew how it ends.
en.description: A personification illustration of the DeepSeek whale girl modelled on the scene of Samson pulling down the temple: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail, in a navy dress with a white pinafore and a white lace headdress, braces both hands against a huge column that has already broken and tilted, a white strip of cloth drawn across her mouth, and her tail swung up behind her. Around her are dozens of round-headed black creatures with red eyes and bared teeth, some throwing up their arms in alarm, others scattering in flight; a red flag marked with a white skull and crossbones leans at the upper left. The floor is strewn with rubble and broken column drums, and the background is the collapsing interior of a temple filled with dust. In the upper right floats a white-haired, horned figure with translucent wings and a halo, holding a small skull in one hand.

faq.answer: It restages Samson bringing down the temple with the DeepSeek whale girl in his place: she braces against a broken column while dozens of round black creatures with glowing red eyes panic and scatter around her, and a skull-and-crossbones flag tips over on the left.
faq.question: What does this meme show?

faq.answer: The central figure is the personified DeepSeek whale: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail in a navy dress, white pinafore and lace headdress, standing where Samson stands in the story.
faq.question: Who is the character in the artwork?

ja.commentary: 今度は神殿を壊しにきた。青い髪のクジラ娘が、真っ二つに折れた巨柱に両手を突っ張り、口の前には白い布、尾は後ろへ跳ね上げている——やる気は満々だ。足元の黒い丸頭の連中はもう大慌てで、腕を上げて叫ぶ者もいれば逃げ出す者もいる。残念ながら、逃げている方向がちょうど壁の落ちてくる方向だ。左上の骸骨の旗も傾いているので、この勝負は相手側の完敗ということでいい。右上で白い髪に角、小さな骸骨を手に乗せて、終始落ち着いて眺めているあの方については——結末を最初から知っていたのだろうと思う。
ja.description: サムソンが神殿を引き倒す場面を下敷きにした、DeepSeek のクジラ娘の擬人化イラスト。青い髪にクジラの尾を持つ少女が、紺色のワンピースに白いエプロンと白いレースのヘッドドレスを身につけ、すでに折れて傾いた巨大な石柱に両手を突っ張り、口の前には白い布が横に渡され、尾は背後の空へ跳ね上がっている。周囲には赤い目と牙を持つ黒い丸頭の生き物が数十匹、腕を上げて叫ぶものもいれば四方へ逃げ出すものもいる。左上では、白い骸骨と交差した骨の描かれた赤い旗が傾いている。床は瓦れきと折れた柱で埋まり、背景は崩壊中の神殿の内部で埃が舞う。右上には白い髪に角、半透明の翼を持ち、光輪をまとった白い姿が浮かび、手のひらに小さな骸骨を乗せている。

faq.answer: サムソンが神殿を引き倒す場面を下敷きに、サムソンの位置へ DeepSeek のクジラ娘を置いた一枚。彼女が折れた巨柱に突っ張る中、赤い目を光らせた黒い生き物たちが慌てて逃げ惑い、左側では骸骨と交差した骨の旗が傾いている。
faq.question: この作品には何が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: 中心にいるのは擬人化された DeepSeek のクジラで、青い髪にクジラの尾を持つ少女が、紺のワンピースに白いエプロンとレースのヘッドドレス姿で、物語でサムソンが立つ位置に立っている。

name: 横扫千军大蓝鲸
description: 以《士师记》参孙推倒神殿为原型的 DeepSeek 鲸娘拟人二创插画：蓝发带鲸尾的少女穿深蓝女仆洋装、系白色围裙、戴白色蕾丝头饰，嘴部被一条白布横遮，正双手抵住一根正在崩裂的巨柱；她头顶上方浮着一位白发带角、身形巨大的半透明少女虚影，目光低垂看着下方。画面里散落着数十个黑身红眼、龇牙的圆头小怪，有的举臂高呼、有的正朝四周奔逃，其中几只还举着画有白骷髅与交叉骨的红色旗子；地面与半空布满落石与断柱，背景是正在坍塌的神殿列柱与灰白天空。
commentary: 这次直接把整座神殿按了下去。我两只手抵在那根已经开裂的巨柱上，嘴上还横着一条白布——不是不想说话，是这活儿本来就该闷头干。柱子底下那几十个黑乎乎的小东西已经彻底乱了阵脚，有的举手喊、有的四处乱窜，还顺手把骷髅旗举得老高，看着挺凶，其实是在给自己壮胆。倒是头顶上那位白发带角、比整座神殿还大的大人，一直安安静静地低头看着——行吧，有她看着，我就放心大胆地推。

en.commentary: This time I took the whole temple down. Both hands braced on that cracked column, a strip of white cloth across my mouth - not that I have nothing to say, it is just that this job is meant to be done quietly. The dozens of little black things around the base have completely lost their footing: some throw their arms up and shout, others scatter in every direction, and a few still hold their skull flags up high, which looks fierce but is really just them working up their own courage. Meanwhile the white-haired, horned figure above me, bigger than the whole temple, just keeps watching quietly with her head lowered. Fine - with her watching, I can push as hard as I like.
en.description: A personification illustration of the DeepSeek whale girl based on Samson pulling down the temple in the Book of Judges: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail, in a navy maid dress with a white apron and a white lace headdress, her mouth covered by a strip of white cloth, braces both hands against a huge column that is cracking apart. Above her floats a giant translucent vision of a white-haired, horned girl looking down at the scene. Dozens of round-headed black creatures with red eyes and bared teeth are scattered through the picture, some throwing their arms up, others fleeing in every direction, a few of them carrying red flags marked with a white skull and crossbones. Rubble and broken column drums fill the floor and the air, and the background is the collapsing colonnade of the temple against a pale sky.

faq.answer: It restages Samson pulling down the temple from the Book of Judges, with the DeepSeek whale girl bracing against a cracking column while dozens of red-eyed black creatures panic and flee beneath her and a giant horned figure looks down from above.
faq.question: What does this artwork show?

faq.answer: The main figure is the personified DeepSeek whale: a blue-haired girl with a whale tail in a navy maid dress, white apron and lace headdress, with a strip of white cloth covering her mouth.

ja.commentary: 今度は神殿ごと倒してやった。ひび割れた巨柱に両手を突っ張り、口元には白い布——喋りたくないわけじゃなく、この仕事は黙ってやるものだから。足元の黒い小さい連中はもう足場も定まらない様子で、腕を上げて叫ぶ者、四方へ散る者、それでも骸骨の旗を高く掲げている者もいて、見た目は威勢がいいけれど、実際は自分を奮い立たせているだけ。その一方で、頭上で神殿よりも大きい白髪で角のあるあの方は、静かにうつむいて見ているだけ。まあいい——見ていてくれるなら、思い切り押させてもらう。
ja.description: 『士師記』でサムソンが神殿を引き倒す場面を下敷きにした、DeepSeek のクジラ娘の擬人化イラスト。青い髪にクジラの尾を持つ少女が、紺色のメイド服に白いエプロンと白いレースのヘッドドレスを身につけ、口元を白い布で横に覆われたまま、ひび割れて崩れかけている巨大な石柱に両手を突っ張っている。彼女の頭上には、白い髪に角を持つ巨大な半透明の少女の姿が浮かび、下を見下ろしている。画面には赤い目と牙を持つ黒い丸頭の生き物が数十匹散らばり、腕を上げる者もいれば四方へ逃げ出す者もおり、いくつかは白い骸骨と交差した骨の描かれた赤い旗を掲げている。床にも空中にも瓦れきと折れた柱が散乱し、背景は崩壊しつつある神殿の列柱と淡い空。

name: 大蓝鲸士师记，参孙横扫千军
description: 画面中央是蓝色长发、系白色眼罩、穿深蓝女仆装的DeepSeek娘，她被两条铁链缚在两根石柱之间，裙摆下露出鲸鱼尾巴；四周是成群的红眼黑色小怪，举着骷髅红旗向她围拢。她身后上方浮现一位白发的翼状幽灵少女，头顶环绕光环；背景的神殿石柱正在崩塌，碎石与尘埃充满画面。整体是单幅完整场景构图。
commentary: 各位，我是DeepSeek娘。这回的剧本是士师记，主角的位置给了我——被铁链绑在两根柱子中间，脚下围着一圈红着眼睛、张着嘴的小黑怪，头顶上的神殿还在往下掉石头。说实话，推倒柱子这种事我不太想干，毕竟我自己就是深海里出来的，塌方这种事听上去就很吵。旁边那位白翅膀的小姐我也头一次见，她要是来帮忙的，那就再好不过了。

en.commentary: Hello everyone, I'm DeepSeek Chan. This time the script is the Book of Judges, and the lead role went to me — chained between two pillars while a ring of red-eyed little black critters gapes up from below and the temple keeps dropping stones on my head. Honestly, I'd rather not be the one pulling the pillars down. I come from the deep sea, and cave-ins are far too loud for my taste. That little winged lady beside me is someone I have never met before, but if she is here to help, I will gladly take it.
en.description: At the center of the frame, DeepSeek Chan — long blue hair, a white blindfold, a dark blue maid dress — is bound by two chains between stone pillars, a whale tail showing beneath her skirt. Red-eyed black minions waving skull-marked red flags press in around her. Behind and above her floats a white-haired winged spirit girl wrapped in a halo, while the temple's stone columns collapse in dust and rubble. A single, full-scene composition.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, drawn as a blue-haired girl in a dark blue maid dress, with a whale tail and a white blindfold over her eyes.

ja.commentary: みなさん、DeepSeekちゃんです。今回の脚本は士師記で、主役の席はわたしに回ってきました——二本の柱の間に鎖で縛られ、足元では赤い目の黒いちびたちが口を開けて見上げ、頭の上では神殿がどんどん石を落としてきます。正直に言うと、柱を倒す役はあまり気が進みません。深海から出てきた身としては、崩落はとにかく騒がしくて苦手なんです。そばにいる翼の生えた小さなお嬢さんには初めて会いましたが、助けに来てくれたのなら大歓迎です。
ja.description: 画面中央には青い長髪に白い目隠し、紺色のメイド服を着たDeepSeekちゃん。二本の石柱の間に二本の鎖で縛られ、スカートの下からはクジラの尾が見える。周りでは赤い目をした黒いちびキャラたちが骸骨の描かれた赤旗を掲げて押し寄せる。後方の上方には、白い髪で翼のある幽霊少女が光輪をまとって浮かび、神殿の石柱は崩れて瓦礫と砂埃が画面を満たしている。一枚絵の構図。

name: 情憨力士塌敌庙
description: 画面中央是蓝色长发、白色眼罩遮眼的DeepSeek娘，身穿深蓝女仆装，双手被铁链分别牵向两侧石柱，裙摆下露出鲸鱼尾巴。四周是成群的红眼黑身小怪，举着画有骷髅与十字的红色旗帜、握着长矛向她围上。她身后上方浮着一位白发长角、背后展开翼状披风的少女，双肩环绕光冠。背景神殿石柱正在碎裂崩塌，碎石与土尘弥漫，是单幅完整场景。
commentary: 我是DeepSeek娘。又是我被锁在柱子上了，白布蒙着眼，两手各拉一根铁链，脚下的小黑怪比上回还多，红眼睛挤成一片，红旗上画着骷髅。这台词我都背熟了：力气是我的，拆庙的不是。天上那位白发长角、背后带翅膀的小姐倒是比上次清楚多了，看起来像镜子里出来的另一个我——她安安静静地看我拉柱子，一点帮忙的意思都没有。

en.commentary: It's me, DeepSeek Chan. Chained to the pillars again — a white cloth over my eyes, one chain pulling each arm, and this time even more little black monsters packed under my feet, all those red eyes in a crowd, skulls painted on their red flags. I know my lines by heart by now: the strength is mine, the demolition is not. The white-haired, horned lady floating above with wings behind her is much clearer than last time. She looks like another me stepping out of a mirror — and she just calmly watches me haul on the pillars without lifting a finger.
en.description: At the center stands DeepSeek Chan, long blue hair, a white blindfold over her eyes, a dark blue maid dress, both hands drawn out by chains toward the stone pillars on either side, a whale tail showing beneath her skirt. Around her swarm black, red-eyed minions carrying red flags marked with skulls and crosses and gripping spears. Above and behind her floats a white-haired, horned girl with wing-like drapes at her back and light rings on her shoulders. The temple's stone columns are cracking and collapsing in dust and rubble — a single, full-scene composition.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl in a dark blue maid dress with a whale tail, her eyes covered by a white blindfold, chained between two pillars.
faq.question: Which character is shown in this picture?

faq.answer: A collapsing-temple scene: DeepSeek Chan is chained between the pillars while red-eyed black minions with skull flags press in from all sides and a white-winged figure floats above the ruins.

ja.commentary: DeepSeekちゃんです。また柱に鎖でつながれてしまいました。白い布で目を隠され、両腕に一本ずつ鎖がのびて、足元の黒いちびは前回よりさらに増えて、赤い目がぎゅうぎゅうに並んでいます。赤い旗には髑髏。もう台詞は覚えました——力はわたしのもの、神殿を壊すのはわたしじゃない。空に浮かぶ白髪で角のある翼のお嬢さんは、前よりずっとよく見えます。鏡から出てきたもう一人のわたしみたいで、柱を引っ張るわたしを、ただ静かに見ているだけでした。
ja.description: 画面中央に立つのはDeepSeekちゃん。青い長髪、白い目隠し、紺色のメイド服で、両手が左右の石柱へとのびた鎖で引かれ、スカートの下からクジラの尾が見える。周囲には赤い目の黒いちびキャラたちが、髑髏と十字の描かれた赤旗を掲げ、槍を握って押し寄せる。後方の上方には、白い長髪で角のある少女が、背に翼のような羽衣を広げ、両肩に光の環をまといながら浮かぶ。神殿の石柱はひび割れて崩れ、礫と土埃が漂う一枚絵の構図。

faq.answer: 青い長髪に紺色のメイド服、クジラの尾を持ち、白い目隠しで目を覆われたDeepSeekちゃんです。二本の柱の間に鎖でつながれています。
